articles.articleText: Enka İnşaat'ın (ENKAI) kârı yüzde 17 geriledi! 3. çeyrek bilançosu beklenti altında kaldı - Enka İnşaat, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 3,42 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin 9 aylık net kârı yıllık yüzde 17 düşüşle 21,87 milyar TL'ye gerilerken, çeyreklik sonuçlar piyasa beklentisini karşılayamadı. Enka İnşaat ve Sanayi A.Ş. (ENKAI), 2026 yılının üçüncü çeyreğine ilişkin finansal sonuçlarını Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımladı. Şirket, temmuz-eylül döneminde 3 milyar 422 milyon 270 bin TL net kâr elde etti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Böylece Enka'nın 2026 yılının ilk dokuz ayındaki toplam net kârı 21 milyar 869 milyon 395 bin TL oldu. Şirketin geçen yılın aynı döneminde açıkladığı 26,28 milyar TL'lik net kârla karşılaştırıldığında, yıllık bazda yüzde 17 düşüş kaydedildi. Kâr beklentilerin altında kaldı Matriks Haber tarafından gerçekleştirilen bilanço anketine 8 aracı kurum katıldı. Ankete göre Enka İnşaat için üçüncü çeyrek ortalama net kâr beklentisi 5 milyar 129 milyon TL, medyan beklenti ise 4 milyar 944 milyon 200 bin TL seviyesindeydi. Şirketin açıkladığı 3,42 milyar TL'lik net kâr, hem ortalama hem de medyan beklentinin altında gerçekleşti. Böylece Enka, üçüncü çeyrek bilançosunda piyasa tahminlerini karşılayamadı. Satışlar yüzde 20 artarken faaliyet kârı geriledi Enka İnşaat'ın 2026 yılının ilk dokuz ayında elde ettiği hasılat, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 108,97 milyar TL'den 130,22 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Böylece satış gelirleri yıllık yüzde 20 artış gösterdi. Buna karşın esas faaliyet kârı 20,66 milyar TL'den 18,24 milyar TL'ye gerileyerek yüzde 12 düşüş kaydetti. FAVÖK de geçen yılki 23,99 milyar TL seviyesinden 23,80 milyar TL'ye indi. Varlıklar ve özkaynaklar yükseldi Enka'nın toplam varlıkları 2025 yıl sonundaki 493,06 milyar TL seviyesinden 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreği itibarıyla 565,13 milyar TL'ye çıktı. Aynı dönemde toplam borçlar 113,52 milyar TL'den 126,29 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Şirketin özkaynakları ise 373,22 milyar TL'den 431,78 milyar TL'ye ulaştı. Özkaynaklarda çeyreklik dönemde yüzde 5 artış kaydedildi. Enka İnşaat'ın 2026 üçüncü çeyrek bilançosu Şirketin piyasa çarpanlarında F/K oranı 15,27, PD/DD oranı 1,12 olarak açıklandı. Enka İnşaat'ın piyasa değeri ise 485,10 milyar TL seviyesinde bulunuyor.

articles.title: Could the US midterms put a pin in the AI bubble?
articles.summary: Fears of more AI regulation appear to have sparked fear among investors, but concerns about the industry have been growing for some time.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Could the US midterms put a pin in the AI bubble?
articles.summaryTr: Fears of more AI regulation appear to have sparked fear among investors, but concerns about the industry have been growing for some time.
articles.articleText: Could the US midterms put a pin in the AI bubble? - Published Is the artificial intelligence (AI) gold rush coming to an end, or is this simply a reality check? That's the question which is hanging over investors, and which has prompted steep falls on the world's stock markets. The sell-off in the US on Thursday was most dramatic on the Nasdaq, home to tech industry titans such as Alphabet, Nvidia, Meta and Apple. It followed sweeping gains by the Democrats in this week's mid-term elections in the US, which have given the party full control of Congress. A number of leading Democrats campaigned against the unhindered expansion of data centres, which have underpinned the growth of artificial intelligence. Fears this will lead to more regulation of AI appear to have sparked fear among investors. But concerns about the industry's prospects have been growing for some time. AI boom The release of Chat GPT by Open AI in late 2022 is widely seen as having generated massive public and corporate interest in the practical uses of AI. It also sparked a modern-day gold rush. Investors flocked to put their money into companies producing computer chips and networking infrastructure, building data centres and providing the energy to power them, as well as developing the AI itself. The value of tech companies soared. The boom continued into this year. Investments in AI are expected to reach $1trillion in 2026 alone according to research by Goldman Sachs. The sector has scooped up so much available cash that other industries have seen their own borrowing costs increase as a result. But investors want returns, and in recent months concerns have been growing about whether the AI boom can produce the expected riches. Those worries have emerged at a time when public comments from AI researchers casting doubt over the safety of AI - even suggesting it could represent an existential threat to humanity - have been grabbing headlines and fuelling speculation that a clampdown could lie ahead. Democrat opposition While the Trump administration has been all-in on AI, or "super intelligence" as the president likes to call it, many leading Democrats have tapped into grassroots concerns about the expansion of data centres and their impact on local communities. These were largely focused on the facilities' high consumption of water and electricity, which many feared would push up their household bills – as well as the noise, use of land, and general disruption associated with them. A Gallup poll published in May showed 71% of Americans would oppose the building of a data centre in their community. The figure for a nuclear power station was 53%. James Talarico, who won the Senate race in once staunchly Republican Texas, was one of those to tap into this scepticism. "While we want to protect America's leadership in artificial intelligence, we are still grappling with how it will affect everything from how we work to how our children learn," he said. "We must protect Americans and establish clear, consistent laws for businesses." With control of both houses of Congress, Democrats are now expected to challenge the president's technology agenda more vigorously, while introducing legislation which could curb the expansion of the industry. Texas' Democratic governor-elect Gina Hinojosa campaigned against data centres, pledging a moratorium on the construction of new facilities. Hinojosa's win could present opposition to tech multi-billionaire Elon Musk, who has moved large parts of SpaceX and Tesla's operations to the state, for years a Republican stronghold. The Tesla boss had spent nearly $450m to back Republican campaigns in the midterms. Where next for stocks? As the co-founder of the British-based technology firm Arm Holdings, Tudor Brown, points out, "stock values are based on future earnings not present earnings". If the rewards are not likely to be as great as expected, some investors will choose to sell up. The falls seen on stock markets over the past 24 hours would appear to have been triggered by the mid-term results. But concerns that tech firms have become overvalued were being expressed long before the elections. The question now is whether this is simply the removal of froth from an over-exuberant market, or a sign that the AI rush is a bubble about to burst, with much wider consequences. Nandini Roy Choudhury of Future Market Insights thinks investors will assess whether the political shift could result in restrictions on data centre construction, energy consumption and the deployment of AI technology. She adds there is unlikely to be an immediate widespread recovery in tech stocks as traders are likely to be more selective, favouring firms with stronger balance sheets. Brown thinks the impact will be limited. Share valuations, he thinks, were inflated by expectations of "almost infinite AI growth", which have been followed by "a bit of a panic". "There is a natural floor to this", he says. "After that it will reflect I think that actually there's still a lot of money being made in these companies".

Şirketin esas faaliyet kârı, 1,06 milyar TL'den 404,8 milyon TL'ye gerileyerek yaklaşık yüzde 62 düşüş kaydetti. FAVÖK ise geçen yılın ilk dokuz ayındaki 1,06 milyar TL seviyesinden 1,10 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. articles.titleTr: SPK'dan kapalı fonlar için açıklama: İşleme açılma kararını portföy şirketleri verecek
articles.summaryTr: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), TEFAS ve TEFAS dışı kanallarda alım satıma kapatılan fonların yeniden işleme açılmasına ilişkin yanlış bilgilendirmelere karşı uyarıda bulundu.
articles.articleText: SPK'dan kapalı fonlar için açıklama: İşleme açılma kararını portföy şirketleri verecek - Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), TEFAS ve TEFAS dışı kanallarda alım satıma kapatılan fonların yeniden işleme açılmasına ilişkin yanlış bilgilendirmelere karşı uyarıda bulundu. - A1 Capital, Bulls ve Pardus Portföy'ün kapalı fonları yeniden işleme açabilmesi için Ziraat Bankası üzerinden SPK'ya başvurması gerekiyor. Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), alım satıma kapatılan yatırım fonlarının yeniden işleme açılmasına ilişkin kamuoyunda yer alan bazı haber ve sosyal medya paylaşımlarının yanlış yönlendirmelere yol açtığını bildirdi. SPK'dan kapalı fonlar için yeni açıklama CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle SPK'nın 6 Kasım 2026 tarihli duyurusunda, 17 Eylül 2026 tarihli Kurul kararlarıyla A1 Capital, Atlas, Bulls, Hedef, Pardus, Pusula ve Tera Portföy Yönetimi şirketlerinin kurucusu olduğu ve katılma payları TEFAS'ta işlem gören tüm yatırım fonlarının hem TEFAS'ta hem de TEFAS dışı dağıtım kanallarında alım satıma kapatıldığı hatırlatıldı. Üç portföy şirketinin fonlarında tasfiye süreci öncelikli 30 Eylül 2026 tarihli ve 2026/67 sayılı SPK Bülteni'nde A1 Capital, Bulls ve Pardus Portföy Yönetimi'nin kurucusu olduğu fonların tasfiye işlemlerine öncelikli olarak başlanacağı açıklanmıştı. Duyuruya göre bu fonların tasfiye süreci tamamlandıktan sonra, aynı şirketlerin tasfiye kapsamında bulunmayan ancak alım satıma kapatılmış diğer fonları yeniden işleme açılabilecek. Fonların açılma tarihini şirketler belirleyecek SPK, kapalı fonların yeniden işleme açılmasının otomatik olarak gerçekleşmeyeceğinin altını çizdi. Fonların hangi tarihte ve hangi alım satım esaslarıyla işleme açılacağına; portföy yapısı, likidite, piyasa koşulları ve yatırımcıların menfaatleri dikkate alınarak ilgili portföy yönetim şirketleri karar verecek. Bu kapsamda A1 Capital, Bulls ve Pardus Portföy Yönetimi şirketlerinin öncelikle Ziraat Bankası'na başvuruda bulunması gerekiyor. Başvuruların banka tarafından SPK'ya iletilmesinin ardından süreç Kurul nezdinde ilerleyecek. SPK'nın açıklaması, kapalı fonların tamamının aynı anda veya belirli bir tarihte yeniden işleme açılacağı anlamına gelmiyor. Yeniden açılma süreci, ilgili şirketlerin başvuruları ve fonların koşulları çerçevesinde şekillenecek.

articles.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
articles.summary: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
articles.summaryTr: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.
articles.articleText: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say - Published A young girl and an 18-year-old man have died after a bus crashed in eastern France, local authorities have said. The bus was travelling between Lyon and Bourg-en-Bresse when it crashed at around 07:00 local time on Friday in the town of Lent, about 34 miles (55km) from the border with Switzerland. The bus was carrying 43 passengers, including 15 children, the Bourg-en-Bresse prosecutor's office said. Three people are in a critical condition and at least 13 others have sustained minor injuries. French President Emmanuel Macron said his thoughts were with the victims, the injured, and their families. In a post on X, he said the nation stood by their side and thanked the rescue teams involved. The town's mayor Yves Cristin told French media the bus "left the road and hit a tree in the ditch". The two people killed have been identified by authorities. However, there have been differing reports as to the age of the girl. The prosecutor's office said it was "opening an investigation into the incident, on charges of road homicide and aggravated road traffic injuries". The driver has been taken to hospital after sustaining injuries and has not yet been questioned by police. French Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot said initial tests indicated there were no traces of alcohol or drugs in his blood. Photos circulating in French media show a blue and white bus tilted in what appears to be a ditch on the roadside. Trees line the side of the road. The front of the bus appears to be heavily damaged. Local mayor Cristin told BFM TV: "I arrived minutes after the accident and people were in shock. "The side of the bus was torn off, and clearly, the people who were on that side must have been seriously injured." Addressing weather conditions at the time of the crash, the mayor told Le Figaro "there was a bit of fog, the road was wet" but there were "no major difficulties". Speaking to the same paper, Fabrice Pannekoucke, head of the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region, said: "At this stage, there are no particular explanations or interpretations that can be given." Tabarot said the bus did not operate "exclusively on school routes" but that there were "many schoolchildren on board". French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said the accident was tragic, and thanked the firefighters, medical teams and police who attended the scene. Earlier, French Education Minister Édouard Geffray said it was "always difficult when our children are victims of accidents of this nature". Emergency services were at the scene and medical helicopters were deployed to take victims with serious injuries to a specialised hospital. More than 100 firefighters and 50 gendarmes were also at the scene. The local town hall was opened to provide shelter and coordinate with emergency services, the local mayor said. articles.articleText: Enerji devi Tüpraş'tan (TUPRS) beklentileri aşan bilanço: İşte detaylar! - Tüpraş, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 68,68 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin 9 aylık kârı yıllık yüzde 328 artışla 121,3 milyar TL'ye yükselirken, sonuçlar piyasa beklentilerinin üzerinde gerçekleşti. Tüpraş (TUPRS), 2026 yılının üçüncü çeyreğine ilişkin finansal sonuçlarını açıkladı. Şirket, temmuz-eylül döneminde 68 milyar 676 milyon 738 bin TL net dönem kârı elde etti. Böylece yılın ilk dokuz ayındaki toplam net kâr 121 milyar 300 milyon 937 bin TL'ye ulaştı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Tüpraş'ın 2025 yılının aynı döneminde açıkladığı 28,31 milyar TL'lik net kâr dikkate alındığında, şirketin 9 aylık kârı yıllık bazda yüzde 328 artış gösterdi. Kâr beklentilerin üzerinde gerçekleşti Matriks Haber tarafından gerçekleştirilen bilanço anketine 11 aracı kurum katıldı. Ankete göre Tüpraş için üçüncü çeyrek ortalama net kâr beklentisi 60 milyar 570 milyon 600 bin TL, medyan beklenti ise 60 milyar 105 milyon TL seviyesindeydi. Şirketin açıkladığı 68,68 milyar TL'lik net kâr, hem ortalama hem de medyan beklentiyi geride bıraktı. Böylece Tüpraş, üçüncü çeyrek bilançosuyla piyasa tahminlerinin üzerinde bir performans sergiledi. Satışlar 1,17 trilyon TL'ye yükseldi Tüpraş'ın 2026 yılının ilk dokuz ayındaki hasılatı, geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 51 artarak 1 trilyon 174 milyar 95 milyon TL'ye çıktı. Şirketin 2025'in ilk dokuz ayında elde ettiği satış geliri 776,24 milyar TL seviyesindeydi. Esas faaliyet kârı ise aynı dönemde yüzde 272 artışla 144 milyar 136 milyon TL'ye yükseldi. FAVÖK de 59,46 milyar TL'den 163,95 milyar TL'ye çıktı. Varlıklar ve özkaynaklar büyüdü Şirketin toplam varlıkları 2025 yıl sonundaki 735,92 milyar TL seviyesinden 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreği itibarıyla 972,08 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Aynı dönemde toplam borçlar 276,16 milyar TL'den 441,26 milyar TL'ye çıktı. Tüpraş'ın özkaynakları ise 452,64 milyar TL'den 522,89 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Şirketin özkaynaklarında çeyreklik dönemde yüzde 21 artış kaydedildi. Tüpraş'ın 2026 üçüncü çeyrek bilançosu Şirketin açıklanan piyasa çarpanlarında F/K oranı 5,01, PD/DD oranı 1,24 olarak yer aldı. Tüpraş'ın piyasa değeri ise 650,30 milyar TL seviyesinde bulunuyor.

articles.title: PM tells firms to publish salaries in job adverts ahead of new law
articles.summary: The government argues the change will help jobseekers and could help to prevent pay discrimination.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: PM tells firms to publish salaries in job adverts ahead of new law
articles.summaryTr: The government argues the change will help jobseekers and could help to prevent pay discrimination.
articles.articleText: PM tells firms to publish salaries in job adverts ahead of new law - Published Businesses should publish salaries in job adverts now, Prime Minister Andy Burnham is telling firms, rather than wait for a new law to come in that will force them to do so. The government is planning to make pay details compulsory in adverts, with legislation on the issue being brought forward "as soon as possible". It argues the change will help jobseekers, particularly those applying for their first job, and could help prevent pay discrimination. However, one industry group said setting pay was a complex process and regulating adverts was not always suitable. It comes a week after the UK's equality watchdog said employees should legally be able to find out what their colleagues are earning. Burnham said the current system felt "weighted against the applicant" and the changes were aimed at "tilting the scales back". "It can be quite soul destroying for young people these days, applying for jobs when the salary is not listed but sometimes they're not getting a reply," he told the BBC. The prime minister added that publishing salaries in adverts was also important for closing the gender pay gap. He was also challenged over whether MPs should be disclosing salaries when advertising for staff in their offices. A number of politicians are currently advertising for roles without giving an expected salary., external Burnham said: "It would apply completely to them too and the call I'm making today is, before the law changes do it voluntarily because it's the right thing to do." Greater transparency The Cabinet Office launched a consultation into pay and reducing discrimination in the summer, and the government said there had been "overwhelming support" for greater transparency, with 94% of respondents backing the move. "Whether you're a young person starting out or a parent trying to support your family, you should know what a job pays before spending your time and effort applying for it," Burnham said. The government said the move was part of attempts to reduce the nearly one million young people not in education, employment or training - or "Neet" - ahead of the final report of the Milburn Review into youth inactivity, which is due in the coming weeks. Publishing salary details upfront could "expose unjustified differences in pay, give workers greater confidence to challenge discrimination and prevent disagreements over pay escalating into disputes". The proposals are similar to measures being introduced in the European Union., external Employers in Europe will have to disclose the initial pay or range for new roles, which must either be included in a published job advert or shared before an interview. According to data from UK jobs website Adzuna, external, 51% of the adverts on its site in September had salary information, but the proportion has been falling in recent years. Adzuna co-founder Andrew Hunter said being open about pay "should be the norm, not the exception". He added that employers who put a salary on a job advert "attract more applicants, and better-suited ones". 'More complicated' Previous research from the CIPD, external, an industry body for human resources managers, has indicated that the public sector and charities are more likely to reveal pay information that private firms, while pay ranges were more common than specific salaries. But it found not all employers were "fully transparent", with pay ranges sometimes wider than £10,000. CIPD chief executive Neil Carberry said that while, in principle, giving salary details was "a good thing", in practice it was "more complicated". "There isn't always a single fixed figure, and employers will want to set pay based on a candidate's skills, experience and potential." Carberry added the process was complex, saying that drafting job adverts is "best left to good employer practice rather than government regulation". The government has said it will set out further details on what information will be required and how the legislation will be enforced "in due course". Conservative shadow business secretary Julia Lopez said: "At a time when employers are finding it harder and harder to take on staff, Labour have decided to make their lives even more difficult. "It should be up to businesses to decide what information they advertise about job openings, and to decide how to attract the best applicants. "As long as they are not being dishonest, misleading or discriminatory, it should not be a matter for the government." Last week, the Equality and Human Rights Commission (EHRC), said publishing salaries in job adverts would be a "positive step". It also said bosses should be required to respond to questionnaires about colleagues' pay to cut pay discrimination. At present, employers do not have to respond to employee requests for salary information about their co-workers. The EHRC also said employers should be prevented from asking about current salary when offering a job to stop a history of discrimination from continuing. Employers in the UK are currently allowed to ask you how much you get paid in your current role, but applicants are under no obligation to tell them. articles.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
articles.summary: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
articles.summaryTr: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.
articles.articleText: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines - Published European airlines have again been hit with a new wave of bomb threats - in the third such incident this week. On Friday multiple flights to and from Lisbon, Rome, Prague and Sofia were targeted and the threats saw three planes escorted by Hungarian fighter jets, authorities said. It also saw a number of high-profile media organisations, including Ireland's public broadcaster RTÉ, evacuated after threats were made against them - although there has been no concrete links between the messages against airlines and the broadcasters yet. The disruption comes after nearly 30 aircraft and several airports across Europe were impacted by bomb threats earlier this week, in what the UK called a "malicious hoax". A Ryanair flight scheduled to leave Lisbon for Rome on Friday was targeted with a threat, the airline said, while at least 11 flights were targeted in the Czech Republic and Bulgaria, according to AFP. France also reported at least four of its flights were targeted by threats, however they all landed safely. No explosives have been found on any planes as of Friday. As airlines were dealing with this latest wave of threats, several media outlets, including RTÉ, were evacuated after similar warnings were made against them. Staff at the Irish Independent newspaper and the Dublin offices of radio stations NewstalkFM and TodayFM, were also advised to leave their buildings and UK broadcaster Sky said it also received a security threat. In a statement, gardaí (Irish police) said they were "aware of a threat made against media organisations here and in Europe". While no link has been established between the threats against airlines and media outlets, the Irish government has warned it is a "likely coordinated campaign of disruption". In a statement, it said: "Hoax threats such as these cause fear, distress and disruption to people going about their daily lives and activities; they achieve no positive purpose whatsoever. It is not known yet who is responsible for these threats, whether it is individuals or a centralised or co-ordinated effort. Irish Prime Minister Micheál Martin described situation as "worrying" and added his government's first priority was the safety of the Irish public. "Yesterday, there appeared to be coordinated efforts to disrupt air travel," he said. Martin told RTÉ it was not yet known if the threats had come from individuals or if it was a "coordinated attack" but said they were being taken seriously. Ireland is scheduled to host two high-profile European Union meetings in Dublin next week. Broadcaster Sky confirmed it had received a security threat, hours after RTÉ had evacuated its building. The broadcaster, which is owned by Comcast, said in a statement read by a presenter on its news channel that the broadcaster had "carried out a security assessment and reported the matter to the relevant authorities". "The safety and security of our colleagues is our primary concern, and we are working closely with authorities to ensure our people and operations remain secure." Friday's disruption comes after the Russian extremist group "Male State", named in this week's hoax bomb threats to Italian airports, denied any link to the false warnings. Replying to the BBC Russian Service, an account on Telegram - one of several linked to the so-called "Male State" and its founder Vladislav Pozdnyakov - mocked any suggestion the group was involved in emailing the threats. "What Male State? Where have you seen it? It hasn't existed for many years," the message on the channel reads. "If tomorrow they sign a [threat] letter, say, from Putin, will you then try to reach our president to ask your stupid question?" - Published2 hours ago - Published19 hours ago

articles.titleTr: Tesla bir modelin fişini çekme kararı aldı: Fabrikada Cybercab dönemi başlıyor
articles.summaryTr: Tesla, beklentilerin altında kalan Cybertruck satışlarının ardından modelin üretimini 2027'nin ortasından itibaren kademeli olarak sonlandıracak. Teksas'taki fabrikada boşalacak üretim alanı sürücüsüz robotaksi Cybercab'e ayrılacak.
articles.articleText: Tesla bir modelin fişini çekme kararı aldı: Fabrikada Cybercab dönemi başlıyor - Tesla, beklentilerin altında kalan Cybertruck satışlarının ardından modelin üretimini 2027'nin ortasından itibaren kademeli olarak sonlandıracak. Teksas'taki fabrikada boşalacak üretim alanı sürücüsüz robotaksi Cybercab'e ayrılacak. Tesla, elektrikli otomobil pazarının en tartışmalı modellerinden Cybertruck için üretimden çekilme kararı aldı. Şirketin CEO'su Elon Musk'ın duyurduğu plana göre aracın üretimi 2027'nin ortasından itibaren kademeli olarak sona erdirilecek. Tesla, Cybertruck'ın üretildiği Teksas'taki Gigafactory tesisinde açılacak kapasiteyi sürücüsüz robotaksi projesi Cybercab için kullanmayı planlıyor. 1 milyon ön sipariş aldı, satış hedefinin gerisinde kaldı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Cybertruck, piyasaya çıkmadan önce 1 milyondan fazla ön sipariş alarak büyük beklenti yaratmıştı. Elon Musk, model için yıllık en az 250 bin adetlik satış hedefi açıklamıştı. Ancak yıllar süren ertelemelerin ardından 2023'te yollara çıkan araç, beklenen ticari başarıyı yakalayamadı. Trapezoid gövde tasarımı ve beklentilerin üzerinde kalan fiyat etiketi, Cybertruck'ın geniş tüketici kitlesine ulaşmasını zorlaştırdı. Cox Automotive verilerine göre model, geçen yıl yaklaşık 20 bin adet satılırken 2026 genelinde teslimatların yaklaşık 16 bin seviyesinde kalması bekleniyor. Tesla Başmühendisi Wes Morrill de aracın dört yıllık serüveninin sona erdiğini doğruladı. Morrill, Cybertruck'ın geliştirme sürecinde Cybercab için önemli bir teknoloji platformu işlevi gördüğünü belirtti. En büyük alıcısı SpaceX oldu Cybertruck'ın son dönemdeki en büyük müşterilerinden biri de Elon Musk'ın diğer şirketi SpaceX oldu. SpaceX'in geçen yıl destek aracı olarak kullanmak üzere 131 milyon dolarlık Cybertruck satın aldığı belirtildi. Tesla'nın yeni odağı robotaksi ve insansı robotlar Cybertruck üretiminin sonlandırılması, Tesla'nın stratejisinde otomobil üretiminden yapay zekâ, otonom sürüş ve robotik teknolojilere doğru yaşanan dönüşümün yeni adımı olarak değerlendiriliyor. Şirket, bu yılın başlarında Model S ve Model X üretimini de Optimus insansı robotuna fabrikada yer açmak amacıyla sonlandırmıştı. Tesla, Teksas ve Florida'daki çeşitli şehirlerde robotaksi ağını genişletmeye çalışırken Optimus robotlarının teslimatlarına gelecek yılın sonuna kadar başlamayı hedefliyor. Tesla yönetim kurulu, robotaksilerden insansı robotlara uzanan teknoloji ekosistemini büyütme stratejisini sürdürürken, olası SpaceX-Tesla birleşmesi de gündemdeki başlıklardan biri olmayı sürdürüyor.

articles.articleText: Tesla Kasım 2026 fiyatları açıklandı: İşte Model Y fiyatı ve kampanyalar! Tesla'nın Türkiye'de satışa sunduğu Model Y ailesinin kasım ayı fiyatları belli oldu. Dört farklı versiyonun fiyatı 2,47 milyon TL ile 4,97 milyon TL arasında değişiyor. Tesla Model Y'nin başlangıç fiyatı 2 milyon 474 bin TL Tesla Model Y ailesinin Türkiye'deki en ulaşılabilir seçeneği Arkadan Çekiş versiyonu oldu. Tamamen elektrikli SUV, günlük kullanıma yönelik çekiş sistemi ve sade donanım tercihleriyle ailenin giriş modelini oluşturuyor. Tesla'nın Kasım 2026 fiyat listesinde bu versiyonun tavsiye edilen anahtar teslim bedeli 2 milyon 474 bin 985 TL olarak açıklandı. Premium Long Range Arkadan Çekiş 3,9 milyon TL Daha uzun menzil arayan kullanıcıları hedefleyen Premium Long Range Arkadan Çekiş versiyonu, Model Y ailesinde daha üst bir donanım ve fiyat seviyesinde konumlanıyor. Bu yapılandırmada 19 inç Crossflow jantlar, All Black iç mekân ve beş koltuklu oturma düzeni sunuluyor. Modelin kasım ayındaki tavsiye edilen anahtar teslim fiyatı 3 milyon 906 bin TL olarak belirlendi. Premium Long Range Dört Çeker 4,62 milyon TL Model Y'nin dört tekerlekten çekişli Premium Long Range seçeneği, uzun menzil beklentisini dört çeker sisteminin sunduğu çekiş avantajıyla birleştiriyor. Bu versiyonda da 19 inç Crossflow jantlar ve All Black iç mekân tercihleri bulunuyor. Tesla'nın kasım ayı fiyat listesinde modelin anahtar teslim bedeli 4 milyon 620 bin TL seviyesinde yer alıyor. Model Y Performance 4 milyon 966 bin TL Model Y ailesinin en üst fiyatlı seçeneği Performance Dört Çeker oldu. Performans odaklı tasarım ayrıntılarıyla diğer versiyonlardan ayrılan modelde 21 inç Arachnid 2.0 jantlar ve All Black iç mekân sunuluyor. Tesla Model Y Performance'ın Kasım 2026 tavsiye edilen anahtar teslim fiyatı 4 milyon 966 bin 500 TL olarak açıklandı. Full Self-Driving aboneliği aylık 4 bin 990 TL Tesla, Model Y'nin tüm versiyonlarında Full Self-Driving kabiliyetini ücretli aylık abonelik seçeneğiyle sunuyor. Söz konusu özellik için açıklanan aylık abonelik bedeli 4 bin 990 TL. Böylece kullanıcılar araç versiyonundan bağımsız olarak bu opsiyona erişebiliyor. Abonelik bedeli araçların anahtar teslim fiyatlarına dahil değil.

Premium Long Range Arkadan Çekiş 3,9 milyon TL Daha uzun menzil arayan kullanıcıları hedefleyen Premium Long Range Arkadan Çekiş versiyonu, Model Y ailesinde daha üst bir donanım ve fiyat seviyesinde konumlanıyor. articles.summary: Fenerbahçe'nin yeni teknik direktörü Emre Belözoğlu için Chobani Stadı'nda imza töreni düzenlendi. Sarı-lacivertli takıma yeniden dönen Belözoğlu, şampiyonluk hedefini vurgulayarak “Fenerbahçe için tutku ve kalite net kriterler” dedi.

articles.titleTr: Emre Belözoğlu Fenerbahçe için imzayı attı: "Hedefimiz şampiyonluk ve kupalar"
articles.summaryTr: Fenerbahçe'nin yeni teknik direktörü Emre Belözoğlu için Chobani Stadı'nda imza töreni düzenlendi. Sarı-lacivertli takıma yeniden dönen Belözoğlu, şampiyonluk hedefini vurgulayarak “Fenerbahçe için tutku ve kalite net kriterler” dedi.
articles.articleText: Emre Belözoğlu Fenerbahçe için imzayı attı: "Hedefimiz şampiyonluk ve kupalar" - Fenerbahçe'nin yeni teknik direktörü Emre Belözoğlu için Chobani Stadı'nda imza töreni düzenlendi. - Sarı-lacivertli takıma yeniden dönen Belözoğlu, şampiyonluk hedefini vurgulayarak "Fenerbahçe için tutku ve kalite net kriterler." dedi. Fenerbahçe Kulübü, teknik direktör Emre Belözoğlu için imza töreni düzenledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Chobani Stadı'nda gerçekleştirilen törende Belözoğlu'nun yanı sıra yöneticiler Önder Fırat ve Cihan Kamer de basın mensuplarının sorularını yanıtladı. Fenerbahçe'ye yeniden dönmenin gururunu yaşadığını belirten Belözoğlu, camianın beklentilerinin farkında olduğunu söyledi. Teknik direktörlük sürecinde kendisini geliştirdiğini ifade eden Belözoğlu, kulübün başarısı için çalışmaya geldiğini vurguladı. "Fenerbahçe için net kriterler tutku ve kalitedir." diyen Belözoğlu, bu anlayışı sahaya yansıtmak istediğini belirterek, oyuncularını en kısa sürede hedefledikleri oyun düzenine adapte edeceklerini kaydetti. "BIST 100 dışında değil, kupaların tamamında hedefimiz var" Belözoğlu, Fenerbahçe'nin mücadele ettiği tüm organizasyonlarda iddialı olması gerektiğini belirtti. Hiçbir maçı veya hedefi ikinci plana atamayacaklarını söyleyen teknik adam, Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde ise gerçekçi bir değerlendirme yapmaları gerektiğini ifade etti. Takımın oyuncu kalitesine güvendiğini dile getiren Belözoğlu, “Fenerbahçe'nin güçlü bir kadrosu var. Oyuncu kalitesine inanıyorum, gelmemin sebeplerinden biri de bu oyuncu grubuna inanmak oldu” diye konuştu. Hedefinin uzun yıllar Fenerbahçe'de görev yapmak olduğunu belirten Belözoğlu, yüzüncü teknik direktörün kulübe üst üste şampiyonluklar ve Avrupa kupaları kazandırmasının ardından görevi devretmesini temenni etti. "Ayrışma olduğunu görüyorum" Fenerbahçe camiasında birlik ve beraberliğin önemine dikkat çeken Belözoğlu, dışarıdan baktığında bir ayrışma gördüğünü söyledi. Bu ayrışmayı ortadan kaldıracak bir oyun anlayışı oluşturmak istediklerini belirten Belözoğlu, "Bunu birleştirecek oyunu oynatmak, şampiyonlukları sonuna kadar kovalamak, her kupaya talip olarak camiaya uygun oyun sergilemek en büyük isteğim." ifadelerini kullandı. Belözoğlu, Fenerbahçe'nin haklarını saha dışında da savunacaklarını belirterek, Merkez Hakem Kurulu ve Türkiye Futbol Federasyonu dahil herkesle kulübün hakları çerçevesinde mücadele edeceklerini söyledi. "Kuyt hocaya saygısızlık yapmak istemem" Liverpool karşısında alınan galibiyete de değinen Belözoğlu, maç öncesinde oyuncularla yalnızca tanıştığını ve kulüple ilgili düşüncelerini paylaştığını anlattı. Takımı karşılaşmaya hazırlayan Dirk Kuyt ve ekibine teşekkür eden Belözoğlu, galibiyette kendisinin payı olduğunu söylemenin doğru olmayacağını belirtti. Kuyt'ın durumuna ilişkin değerlendirme sürecinin sürdüğünü, teknik ekibinin ise 12-13 kişiden oluşacağını açıkladı. Yönetimden Belözoğlu'na şampiyonluk desteği Fenerbahçe yöneticisi Cihan Kamer, İsmail Kartal ile yolların ayrıldığını belirterek Emre Belözoğlu ile şampiyonluk yolunda devam etme kararı aldıklarını söyledi. Önder Fırat da Belözoğlu'nun bilgi, birikim ve tecrübesine güvendiklerini ifade ederek yönetim olarak yeni teknik direktöre destek vereceklerini kaydetti. Emre Belözoğlu'nun kariyeri Futbolculuk kariyerini noktalamasının ardından 15 Ağustos 2020 tarihinde Fenerbahçe'de sportif direktörlük görevine getirilen Emre Belözoğlu, 25 Mart 2021 tarihinde Erol Bulut ile yolların ayrılmasının ardından sarı-lacivertlilerin teknik direktörü olmuştu. Zirvenin uzağında aldığı sarı-lacivertlileri son haftaya kadar şampiyonluk yarışında tutan Belözoğlu, sezonun sona ermesinin ardından görevinden ayrılmıştı. 12 Ekim 2021 tarihinde Başakşehir'le anlaşan genç teknik adam, burada geçirdiği 2 yılda 88 maça çıktı. 2021-22 sezonunda devraldığı takımını ilk 4'e sokan Belözoğlu, 2022-23 sezonunda 5. sırada yer aldı. 2023-24 sezonuna da Başakşehir'de başlayan Emre Belözoğlu, takımının ligde aldığı üst üste 3 yenilgi sonrası görevinden ayrılmıştı. 6 Eylül 2023'te Başakşehir'den ayrılan Belözoğlu, bir süre sonra 5 Ekim 2023 tarihinde Ankaragücü'nün başına geçti. Başkent ekibiyle kümede kalma mücadelesi veren Emre Belözoğlu, takımının bir alt lige düşmesine engel olamadı ve sezonun bitimiyle görevindena yrıldı. 17 Ocak 2025'te yeniden sahalara dönen Belözoğlu, Antalyaspor'un başına getirildi. Akdeniz ekibiyle 28 maça çıkan ve takımını ligde tutan Emre Belözoğlu, 8 Ekim 2025'te veda etti. Şu anda Kasımpaşa'yı çalıştıran Belözoğlu, buradaki görevine 5 Aralık 2025'te başladı. Belözoğlu, 3 Kasım'da Fenerbahçe ile anlaşmaya vardı.

articles.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
articles.summary: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
articles.summaryTr: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.
articles.articleText: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values - Published Shares in artificial intelligence and technology firms have started to climb following an enormous sell-off on Thursday that wiped trillions of dollars off stock values. The tech-heavy Nasdaq stock index opened higher following a market rout that began in the US on Thursday before spilling over to Asian and European markets into Friday. Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat victory in the midterm elections would mean slower artificial intelligence development. However the latest US employment figures added to a mixed picture for American markets on Friday morning, with an unexpectedly strong 165,000 jobs added to the economy in September. The Nasdaq Composite opened up 1.23% and continued to gain in early trading, reversing some of its 5.5% fall from Thursday. The S&P 500 - home of the largest publicly-traded US companies that are not in the technology sector - also opened up slightly, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average opened a little down. Firms that experienced heavy losses on Thursday also began to bounce back in early trading. Nvida, which shed hundreds of billions in market value on Thursday after shares slid more than 9%, began Friday trading up more than 6%. SpaceX and Tesla shares, which were also hammered on Thursday, saw more mixed gains, up more than 7% and nearly 3% respectively. The market fluctuations come after the sweeping Democrat victory in the midterm elections. A number of Democrats campaigned for new rules and regulations for artificial intelligence (AI) and data centres, and the party has since won control of both houses of congress as well as key contests in states that have been part of the AI data centre race. US President Donald Trump on Friday reiterated his supported for what he calls "super intelligence", saying only "foolish leadership" would "say no to the riches they bring". However, there have also been concerns over whether the enormous amounts of money being spent on AI will pay off. - Could the US midterms put a pin in the AI bubble? - Published10 minutes ago As well as the fallout of the midterms and the plunge in artificial intelligence stocks, US traders will also be digesting the latest jobs figures. And those numbers were better than expected: US employers added 165,000 new jobs in October, well above the average monthly increase and more than double what analysts had expected. Overall the unemployment rate, which counts the number of people who are out of work but actively looking for a job, eased slightly to 4.1% from 4.2% in September. The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) said the unemployment rate has remained in the narrow range of 4.1% to 4.3% since March. The increase in jobs was led by the professional and business services sector, which added 70,000 jobs. The healthcare sector added 42,000 jobs, and jobs were also added in transportation and warehousing as well as manufacturing. Neil Birrell, chief investment officer at investment firm Premier Miton, said while the jobs figures may feel like second billing to the market movements they were still important. "The US economy is running hard which may mean the risks the markets are worrying about at the moment are not such a risk to the real economy as is being feared," he said.

articles.title: GTA 6 ön siparişinde 7,7 milyon barajı aşıldı: Daha çıkmadan 2 milyar dolar gelir!
articles.summary: Sensor Tower tahminlerine göre GTA 6, PlayStation ve Xbox platformlarında 7,71 milyon ön sipariş satışına ulaştı. Satışların yüzde 74'ü PlayStation üzerinden gerçekleşirken, oyunun çıkışına kadar 2 milyar dolarlık gelir elde etmesi bekleniyor.

articles.summaryTr: Sensor Tower tahminlerine göre GTA 6, PlayStation ve Xbox platformlarında 7,71 milyon ön sipariş satışına ulaştı. Satışların yüzde 74'ü PlayStation üzerinden gerçekleşirken, oyunun çıkışına kadar 2 milyar dolarlık gelir elde etmesi bekleniyor.
articles.articleText: GTA 6 ön siparişinde 7,7 milyon barajı aşıldı: Daha çıkmadan 2 milyar dolar gelir! - Sensor Tower tahminlerine göre GTA 6, PlayStation ve Xbox platformlarında 7,71 milyon ön sipariş satışına ulaştı. Satışların yüzde 74'ü PlayStation üzerinden gerçekleşirken, oyunun çıkışına kadar 2 milyar dolarlık gelir elde etmesi bekleniyor. Sensor Tower verilerine göre konsollardaki toplam brüt gelir 751 milyon dolara ulaştı. Bu tutarın 559 milyon doları PlayStation, 129 milyon doları ise Xbox platformundan elde edildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Böylece PlayStation, hem satış adedinde hem de gelir tarafında Xbox'a önemli ölçüde fark attı. Veriler, oyunun farklı sürümlerine ilişkin ayrıntılı dağılımı ise tam olarak ortaya koymuyor. Ön siparişlerin yüzde 89'u Ultimate Edition Sensor Tower'ın daha önce paylaştığı tahminlere göre ön siparişlerin yüzde 89'u 100 dolarlık Ultimate Edition sürümünden geldi. articles.articleText: Watch: Is it the end of the road for Tesla's Cybertruck? Tesla CEO Elon Musk has said production of the firm's Cybertruck is "winding down" in Texas, to focus on its self-driving Cybercab cars. The model is only produced at Tesla's Austin base, and he did not clarify if manufacturing would be moved elsewhere or simply cease. The Cybertruck has received a mixed response since its launch in 2023, with some praising its individuality and others simply labelling it ugly. It has also suffered from disappointing sales, quality problems and recalls. BBC's technology reporter Shiona McCallum has this report.

articles.articleText: İngiliz yayın kuruluşu Sky'a saldırı tehdidi: Güvenlik incelemesi başlatıldı - İrlanda kamu yayıncısı RTE'nin de aralarında bulunduğu medya kuruluşlarına yönelik bombalı saldırı tehditlerinin ardından İngiliz yayın kuruluşu Sky da tehdit aldığını açıkladı. - Sky, güvenlik incelemesi başlatıldığını ve ilgili kurumlarla iletişime geçildiğini bildirdi. İngiliz yayın kuruluşu Sky, İrlanda'daki medya kuruluşlarını hedef alan bombalı saldırı tehditlerinin ardından kendisinin de güvenlik tehdidi aldığını duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Sky'dan yapılan açıklamada, "Sky da güvenlik tehdidi alan diğer medya organizasyonlarından biri" ifadeleri kullanıldı. Açıklamada, konuyla ilgili güvenlik incelemesi yapıldığı ve durumun ilgili kurumlara iletildiği belirtildi. Şirket, çalışanlarının ve operasyonlarının güvenliğini sağlamak için yetkili kurumlarla yakın iş birliği içinde çalışıldığını bildirdi. İrlanda'da medya kuruluşları binalarını tahliye etti Bu sabah aralarında İrlanda kamu yayıncısı RTE'nin de bulunduğu bazı medya kuruluşlarına e-posta yoluyla bombalı saldırı tehdidi gönderildi. Tehditlerin ardından kuruluşlar binalarını tahliye ederken canlı yayınlarını da durdurdu. Tehdit alan kuruluşlardan Virgin Media ise binasını boşaltmayarak yayınlarına devam etme kararı aldı. İrlanda Başbakanı Micheal Martin, tehditlerin Avrupa genelinde havacılık sektöründe benzer ihbarlar nedeniyle yaşanan aksaklıkların sürdüğü bir dönemde geldiğine dikkat çekti. Martin, gelişmelerin koordineli bir aksatma kampanyasının parçası olmasının muhtemel göründüğünü ifade etti.

articles.title: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of inciting unrest but acquitted of treason
articles.summary: The 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, says the charges are politically motivated.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of inciting unrest but acquitted of treason
articles.summaryTr: The 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, says the charges are politically motivated.
articles.articleText: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of inciting unrest but acquitted of treason - Published Tanzania's main opposition leader, Tundu Lissu, has been found guilty of inciting unrest and sentenced to four years in jail, in a case that has raised concerns about political freedom in the East African country. A panel of three judges at the High Court in Dar es Salaam acquitted him of the more serious offence of treason, saying prosecutors had failed to prove a key element of that charge. But they said the 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, had encouraged his supporters to disrupt the disputed 2025 general election. Lissu, who leads the opposition Chadema party, has denied the charges, describing the prosecution as politically motivated. The court said his campaign slogan "No Reforms, No Election" was sufficient for him to be convicted of the charge of incitement. "By uttering those words with the intention of disseminating them to the public, the accused incited the public to disrupt the 2025 elections," the court ruled. Lissu said he had only been charged with treason, not incitement. "The offence of incitement is one that you, honourable judges, have manufactured. You have created an offence that did not exist, and you have done so on political directives," Lissu told the court. He added that he would like to apply for bail as this was possible for incitement, unlike treason. He has leave to appeal at the Court of Appeal - the country's highest court. But if the four-year sentence is upheld, it would rule him out of the next elections, due in 2030. Treason is among Tanzania's most serious offences and can carry the death penalty. Human rights group Amnesty International described his conviction as a "travesty of justice". "Tundu Lissu should never have been arrested, let alone prosecuted and convicted," said its regional director for East and Southern Africa, Tigere Chagutah: President Samia Suluhu Hassan won the October 2025 election with 98% of the vote - a result the opposition dismissed the result as a "mockery" of democracy as her two main challengers, including Lissu, were excluded. Her government has repeatedly denied targeting its opponents. The Chadema leader was arrested six months before the poll, shortly after launching a campaign demanding changes to the electoral system under the slogan "No Reforms, No Election". Prosecutors accused him of making statements intended to incite the public to disrupt the election and threaten the government. They argued that his remarks, which were also circulated online, amounted to treason. But Lissu, a lawyer who represented himself during the trial, maintained that his comments were part of a legitimate political campaign for constitutional and electoral reform. He argued that prosecutors had taken his statements out of context and failed to prove that he had committed any crime. Some of the demands raised by Chadema were: - Electoral commissioners should be independently appointed (not by the president) - Police should allow all parties to campaign free of intimidation - Government-appointed district chiefs should no longer act as returning officers - Party agents should be able to observe counting without harassment - It should be possible to challenge presidential election results in court. During his time in remand custody at Dar es Salaam's Ukonga Prison, Lissu went on hunger strike twice for brief periods when he said he was not allowed access to his lawyers or relatives. He also complained that guards listened to what should have been private consultations his lawyers. These allegations have been denied by the prison authorities. His case has attracted international attention, with rights groups expressing concern about the treatment of opposition politicians and the shrinking space for political dissent in Tanzania. Last year's election was followed by widespread protests and a violent security crackdown that left at least 500 people dead, according to an official inquiry. Opposition groups have said the death toll was much higher and demanded an independent investigation. The government has defended its handling of the unrest and rejected accusations of widespread political repression. Samia, 66, has insisted the election was fair and transparent and blamed foreigners for the unrest, saying it was part of a plot to overthrow her. She has set up another commission to inquiry to identify those behind the violence. Lissu has long been one of Tanzania's most outspoken critics of the ruling Chama Cha Mapinduzi (CCM) party, which, along with its predecessor Tanu, has dominated the country's politics since independence. He first became an MP in 2010, representing a constituency near his birth place in Singida, 320km (200 miles) north-west of the capital, Dodoma. In September 2017, the Chadema politician narrowly survived an assassination attempt when gunmen sprayed his vehicle with bullets outside his home in Dodoma. He was shot multiple times and underwent extensive medical treatment abroad. The attack, whose perpetrators have never been brought to justice, forced him to spend years in exile. He returned to contest the 2020 presidential election against the late President John Magufuli, but lost in a vote that the opposition alleged was marred by widespread irregularities. Lissu subsequently returned to exile before coming back to Tanzania in 2023, following President Samia's decision to lift a ban on opposition political rallies. His return was initially seen as a sign of renewed political openness after years of restrictions under Magufuli, who died in office in 2021. But relations between the government and the opposition deteriorated as the country approached the 2025 election. Lissu became Chadema's national chairman in January 2025 and intensified his demands for electoral reforms. His conviction is likely to deepen concerns about the state of democracy in Tanzania. Last week, Amnesty accused the government of continuing its crackdown following the election and "weaponising counterterrorism laws to silence critics and instil fear". The authorities did not respond to a request for comment. Correction: An initial version of this story said Lissu had been convicted of inciting treason. We have corrected this to incitement. articles.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
articles.summary: Paul Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus".
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
articles.summaryTr: Paul Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus".
articles.articleText: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people - Published A Kenyan court has sentenced the leader of a doomsday cult, Paul Mackenzie, to 200 years in prison for murdering 191 people, all but one of them children. Alongside 28 others, Mackenzie was found guilty of the murders for instructing members of his cult to starve their children to death so they could "meet Jesus". Justice Diana Mochache said Mackenzie bore the "primary criminal culpability" for ordering his followers to fast to death, in one of the world's deadliest episodes of cult activity. "The sentence is appropriate and just, to send an unmistakable message that such atrocities warrant the maximum penalties allowed by law," the judge added. The self-styled pastor was arrested in 2023 after the discovery of more than 400 bodies in shallow graves in Shakahola forest near the Kenyan coast. The sprawling investigation into the cases shocked Kenya and drew international attention. The court sentenced Mackenzie to 100 years in prison for homicide and another 100 years for offences related to starvation. The sentences within each category will run concurrently, but the two sets will run consecutively, bringing his total prison term to 200 years. Mackenzie also faces separate manslaughter and terrorism charges, which he denies. Prosecutors had sought the death penalty, arguing that the scale and circumstances of the killings warranted the harshest punishment. However, Justice Mochache declined to impose the death penalty, despite ruling that the case met the threshold for its consideration. "Nevertheless, the court declines the invitation to impose the death penalty on any of the victims," she said, adding that capital punishment would eliminate any prospect of rehabilitation and disengagement. The death sentence has not been carried out in Kenya since 1987. Mackenzie was tried alongside 28 accomplices, including guards who enforced his fasting orders and gravediggers who helped conceal the victims' bodies in mass graves. They received varying prison sentences of up to 160 years. Justice Mochache described the killings as "cold and calculated", saying the perpetrators had shown no remorse and had even declared their willingness to fast to death themselves. Before the hearing began on Friday morning, Francis Wanje, who lost eight relatives including two grandchildren in Shakahola forest, told the BBC's Newsday programme that he was "hoping for... a sentence which will match his [Mackenzie's] deeds in the forest". Mackenzie and the co-accused had asked for leniency from the court. Before their conviction on 19 October, they had all pleaded not guilty and repeatedly insisted that nobody was forced to die. Mackenzie's followers believed he was "Jesus's mouthpiece", Justice Mochache said as she delivered her eight-hour judgement last month. Those who opposed Mackenzie's teachings were beaten to death. One of his co-accused said he had told his followers that anyone who "resisted the directive to fast must be forced to go to heaven through kicks and blows". Burials inside the forest where the cult was based were called "weddings" and those who died "were celebrated as having wedded with Jesus" the judge said. The judge found that the deaths arose from an organised system, including religious teachings and directives that compelled followers to follow the deadly fasting. Post-mortem results showed the cause of deaths to be starvation for most victims, while others died from suffocation, strangulation or head injuries. The cause of death could not be determined for some, with their bodies having decomposed, while others died soon after their rescue as they were so emaciated. The Shakahola deaths have shone a spotlight on the lack of oversight of rogue religious activities and how they could have carried on for so long. The gravity of the case prompted President William Ruto to set up a commission of inquiry, although this was later declared unconstitutional. Investigations by the state-funded Kenya National Commission on Human Rights (KNCHR) revealed that local administration and law enforcement officials had repeatedly turned a blind eye to the cult's activities. "We expected at that time the police would take action immediately to go and rescue the other members there, but it didn't happen," said Wanje, who reported the case to the police in March 2023. Wanje said a relative of his in the police force and a former cult participant had managed to save his grandson at the time. The child told the police what had happened and showed them the grave of his siblings. "It was [supposed to be] his last day.. they [would have killed] my grandson." The cult leader had previously been arrested and later released for lack of evidence. Mackenzie established Good News International Ministries in 2003. Over the next 16 years, the church grew in popularity, drawing thousands of followers in its branches across Kenya. The church ran a television station called Times TV which would broadcast his sermons from his church in Malindi. articles.articleTextTr: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people - Published A Kenyan court has sentenced the leader of a doomsday cult, Paul Mackenzie, to 200 years in prison for murdering 191 people, all but one of them children. Alongside 28 others, Mackenzie was found guilty of the murders for instructing members of his cult to starve their children to death so they could "meet Jesus". Justice Diana Mochache said Mackenzie bore the "primary criminal culpability" for ordering his followers to fast to death, in one of the world's deadliest episodes of cult activity. "The sentence is appropriate and just, to send an unmistakable message that such atrocities warrant the maximum penalties allowed by law," the judge added. The self-styled pastor was arrested in 2023 after the discovery of more than 400 bodies in shallow graves in Shakahola forest near the Kenyan coast. The sprawling investigation into the cases shocked Kenya and drew international attention. The court sentenced Mackenzie to 100 years in prison for homicide and another 100 years for offences related to starvation. The sentences within each category will run concurrently, but the two sets will run consecutively, bringing his total prison term to 200 years. Mackenzie also faces separate manslaughter and terrorism charges, which he denies. Prosecutors had sought the death penalty, arguing that the scale and circumstances of the killings warranted the harshest punishment. However, Justice Mochache declined to impose the death penalty, despite ruling that the case met the threshold for its consideration. "Nevertheless, the court declines the invitation to impose the death penalty on any of the victims," she said, adding that capital punishment would eliminate any prospect of rehabilitation and disengagement. The death sentence has not been carried out in Kenya since 1987. Mackenzie was tried alongside 28 accomplices, including guards who enforced his fasting orders and gravediggers who helped conceal the victims' bodies in mass graves. They received varying prison sentences of up to 160 years. Justice Mochache described the killings as "cold and calculated", saying the perpetrators had shown no remorse and had even declared their willingness to fast to death themselves. Before the hearing began on Friday morning, Francis Wanje, who lost eight relatives including two grandchildren in Shakahola forest, told the BBC's Newsday programme that he was "hoping for... a sentence which will match his [Mackenzie's] deeds in the forest". Mackenzie and the co-accused had asked for leniency from the court. Before their conviction on 19 October, they had all pleaded not guilty and repeatedly insisted that nobody was forced to die. Mackenzie's followers believed he was "Jesus's mouthpiece", Justice Mochache said as she delivered her eight-hour judgement last month. Those who opposed Mackenzie's teachings were beaten to death. One of his co-accused said he had told his followers that anyone who "resisted the directive to fast must be forced to go to heaven through kicks and blows". Burials inside the forest where the cult was based were called "weddings" and those who died "were celebrated as having wedded with Jesus" the judge said. The judge found that the deaths arose from an organised system, including religious teachings and directives that compelled followers to follow the deadly fasting. Post-mortem results showed the cause of deaths to be starvation for most victims, while others died from suffocation, strangulation or head injuries. The cause of death could not be determined for some, with their bodies having decomposed, while others died soon after their rescue as they were so emaciated. The Shakahola deaths have shone a spotlight on the lack of oversight of rogue religious activities and how they could have carried on for so long. The gravity of the case prompted President William Ruto to set up a commission of inquiry, although this was later declared unconstitutional. Investigations by the state-funded Kenya National Commission on Human Rights (KNCHR) revealed that local administration and law enforcement officials had repeatedly turned a blind eye to the cult's activities. "We expected at that time the police would take action immediately to go and rescue the other members there, but it didn't happen," said Wanje, who reported the case to the police in March 2023. Wanje said a relative of his in the police force and a former cult participant had managed to save his grandson at the time. The child told the police what had happened and showed them the grave of his siblings. "It was [supposed to be] his last day.. they [would have killed] my grandson." The cult leader had previously been arrested and later released for lack of evidence. Mackenzie established Good News International Ministries in 2003. Over the next 16 years, the church grew in popularity, drawing thousands of followers in its branches across Kenya. The church ran a television station called Times TV which would broadcast his sermons from his church in Malindi. His End Days sermons included conspiracy theories that described education as "evil", healthcare as "against the doctrine" and digital identity cards as "the mark of the devil". The main church shut down in 2019 and Mackenzie moved to Shakahola forest, encouraging his devotees to follow him. While the conclusion of the murder cases may bring a sense of justice for the victims and their families, the convictions only account for 191 victims, while more than 400 bodies were exhumed from the forest. articles.titleTr: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act
articles.summaryTr: The CLARITY Act faces a new test as Democrats control Congress, raising questions over consumer protections, ethics and what the crypto industry may have to concede.
articles.articleText: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act The CLARITY Act faces a new test as Democrats control Congress, raising questions over consumer protections, ethics and what the crypto industry may have to concede. Crypto companies contributed $233 million to political committees during the 2026 US midterm cycle, according to Public Citizen’s analysis of federal filings. Democrats won both chambers of Congress and will take control in January, giving them a chance to reshape the stalled CLARITY Act, a bill to set federal rules for crypto markets. In Ohio, Democrat and longtime crypto skeptic Sherrod Brown defeated Republican Sen. Jon Husted despite crypto-backed political action committees spending $64 million to defeat him. Senator Elizabeth Warren, one of crypto’s most vocal critics in Washington and the most senior Democrat on the Senate Banking Committee, is expected to chair the panel in the next Congress. Stronger consumer protections, tougher scrutiny of political conflicts and a shift in regulatory power are all likely to be on the docket in the next round of negotiations. But a Democratic majority doesn’t have to kill the prospect of crypto market structure legislation completely. Democrat Congressman Shri Thanedar remains hopeful that the CLARITY Act can still pass, but says any legislation must include stronger ethics requirements. He tells Magazine: “President Trump’s blatant corruption has set back progress on crypto legislation, so Democrats will need strong anti-corruption provisions that apply to the President, not just Congress.” Can the industry’s political influence still be converted into legislation, and what will it have to concede to get there? A different deal for crypto The Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act in September, with disagreements over ethics provisions contributing to the impasse. The crypto spent $233 million on the 2026 US midterm elections. Source: Public Citizen Democrats are already reportedly discussing how to reshape the market structure debate, with House Democrats said to be considering expanding proposals from Representative Maxine Waters into a broader market structure bill. Related: Trump’s memecoin ventures derailed CLARITY Act, Scaramucci says That bill could include stronger consumer protections, a greater role for the Securities and Exchange Commission, and new ethics restrictions on public officials’ crypto activities. That could finally mean separating the industry’s push for clearer rules from the controversies surrounding Trump’s personal crypto ventures. Democrats have already signaled plans to investigate the Trump family’s business dealings and other corporate interests, with incoming House Oversight Committee Chair Robert Garcia planning to pursue inquiries into corporate corruption. Hadley Stern, head of institutions at Silence Laboratories and founder of Fidelity Digital Assets, says Democrats are right to “go after” the second, and the industry should want them to; that’s “what’s poisoning the bipartisan deal,” he says. “A sitting president’s family launching memecoins and a stablecoin is a real governance problem,” he tells Magazine. “If I’d done that at Fidelity, I’d have been walked out the same afternoon.” He says 2026’s digital asset industry is very different from the last time Democrats “held the gavel,” pointing to its growth from “FTX and a bunch of tokens” in 2022 to a federal law for stablecoins, Treasuries and credit funds onchain and tokenized equities on the way: “You don’t regulate that by pretending it doesn’t exist.” What would the industry have to concede? The industry may also have to accept more demanding standards if it wants legislation that can survive changes in political control. Paul Brody, founder and CEO of Nightfall Networks and former global blockchain lead at EY, expects banks “to come out winners,” as they will “push for crypto companies” to be held to the same exacting consumer protection and security standards. Related: Crypto Biz: CLARITY Act setback puts Coinbase in the spotlight He says the industry has opposed this, but tells Magazine that “a wise strategy” would be to “accept similar conditions,” given that blockchain-native ecosystems are still “vastly more flexible, programmable and efficient.” Lindsay Fraser, chief policy officer at Blockchain Association, also argues consumer protection and innovation should not be treated as competing objectives. “We can protect consumers while ensuring the law reflects how the technology actually works,” she says, adding the goal is “lasting policy that earns public trust, gives builders a future in this country, and strengthens American financial leadership.” That doesn’t mean it’s all smooth sailing to a potential compromise. Brody says there’s still the possibility of a presidential veto, and points out that crypto is likely to be a “low priority” compared to “investigations of corruption and battles over budgets and the war.” How the Binance hack could influence lawmakers The midterm results came as lawmakers were already grappling with the fallout from the Binance hack, the largest hack in crypto history, with over $6.3 billion stolen on Oct. 29, raising fresh concerns about exchange security and customer protections. Thanedar says while the legislation “wouldn’t solve every potential problem,” it would provide “much-needed certainty” and “security guardrails,” and the hack provides a “clear example of the danger of not enacting appropriate legislation.” Maylea Ma, deputy general counsel at 1inch, says rather than making a stronger case for passing the latest draft of CLARITY, the incident “highlights problems the legislation does not address.” The hack involved a “centralized exchange’s hot wallet and signing failure,” Ma says, but the current draft “has no insurer, no loss payee, and no hot wallet cap that would have mitigated the loss for Binance or imposed security standards that would have prevented the hack.” Amanda Fischer, policy director at Better Markets, said the episode highlighted how “unfit for purpose the crypto ecosystem is for mainstream finance,” and crypto exchanges should not act as custodians, since it creates a “honeypot risk.” Binance hack shows how ‘unfit’ crypto is for mainstream finance. Source: Amanda Fischer Ma says the incident is “likely to impact” the next vote on CLARITY and could make lawmakers less willing to pass legislation the industry wants, unless it comes with stronger consumer protections. Crypto spent years convincing Washington it deserves a seat at the table; now it will need to agree on the obligations that come along with it. Magazine: Bitcoin turns 18: Has the original rebel grown up?

articles.articleText: Elon Musk'a bir darbe daha: Dev fon Tesla'dan çıktı, SpaceX'te satışa geçti - Seçim sonrası Tesla ve SpaceX hisselerinde yaşanan sert düşüşün ardından Elon Musk'a bir kötü haber de dev yatırım fonundan geldi. Scottish Mortgage Investment Trust, 13 kat getiri sağladığı Tesla'daki tüm hisselerini satarken SpaceX'teki payını da azalttı. Elon Musk'ın şirketlerinin ilk büyük yatırımcılarından Scottish Mortgage Investment Trust, portföyünde önemli değişikliklere gitti. Baillie Gifford tarafından yönetilen ve Londra Borsası'nda işlem gören yatırım fonu, Tesla'daki hisselerinin tamamını elden çıkarırken SpaceX'teki pozisyonunu da önemli ölçüde küçülttü. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Fonun cuma günü açıkladığı altı aylık finansal sonuçlara göre, SpaceX'in toplam varlıklar içindeki payı 30 Eylül'deki yüzde 15 seviyesinden 4 Kasım itibarıyla yüzde 11,1'e geriledi. Scottish Mortgage, Tesla'daki kalan hisselerini ise nisan ayında satarak 2013'te başlayan yatırımını tamamen sonlandırdı. Tesla yatırımından 13 kat getiri sağladı Scottish Mortgage, Tesla'ya ilk yatırımını 2013 yılında gerçekleştirdi. Fon, yaklaşık 13 yıl boyunca sürdürdüğü yatırımından önemli kazanç elde etti. Temmuz ayında açıklanan verilere göre Tesla'ya yaklaşık 470 milyon dolar yatıran fon, bu süreçte yaklaşık 6,2 milyar dolar gerçekleşmiş kâr sağladı. Şirket, yatırımının başlangıç sermayesinin 13 katına ulaşan getiri sunduğunu bildirdi. Fon yönetimi, Tesla'dan çıkış kararında şirketin otonom sürüş ve robotik alanlarındaki büyüme potansiyelinin hisse fiyatına büyük ölçüde yansımış olmasının etkili olduğunu belirtti. Ayrıca Tesla'nın temel otomotiv faaliyetlerinde, özellikle Çin pazarında artan rekabetin de yatırım kararında rol oynadığı ifade edildi. SpaceX'teki payını azalttı Scottish Mortgage'ın SpaceX yatırımı da fonun en başarılı işlemleri arasında yer aldı. Fon, Elon Musk'ın uzay şirketine ilk yatırımını Aralık 2018'de, SpaceX'in yaklaşık 31 milyar dolar değerlemeye sahip olduğu dönemde yaptı. 2021 yılına kadar şirkete yaklaşık 200 milyon dolarlık yatırım taahhüdünde bulundu. SpaceX'in roket fırlatma faaliyetlerini genişletmesi ve Starlink uydu internet ağını büyütmesiyle yatırımın değeri hızla arttı. Haziran 2026'da gerçekleştirilen halka arz sırasında SpaceX, Scottish Mortgage'ın portföy değerinin yaklaşık dörtte birini oluşturuyordu. Halka arz sonrasında hisse satış kısıtlamalarının aşamalı olarak kaldırılmasıyla fon, SpaceX hisselerinin bir bölümünü sattı. Scottish Mortgage yönetimi, buna rağmen SpaceX'in uzun vadeli büyüme potansiyeline yönelik olumlu görüşünü koruduğunu vurguladı. Fon, pozisyonun azaltılmasını portföy yönetiminde risklerin dengelenmesine yönelik bir adım olarak değerlendirdi. Fonun altı aylık getirisi yüzde 31,5 oldu SpaceX yatırımı, Scottish Mortgage'ın finansal performansına da önemli katkı sağladı. Fonun 30 Eylül'de sona eren altı aylık dönemde net varlık değeri bazındaki toplam getirisi yüzde 31,5'e ulaştı. Aynı dönemde FTSE All-World Endeksi yüzde 16 getiri sağlarken fonun hisse fiyatındaki yükseliş yüzde 33,8 oldu. SpaceX yatırımı tek başına fonun toplam getirisine yaklaşık 8 puan katkıda bulundu. Şirket ayrıca SpaceX hisselerinin satışından elde edilen gelirin borçların geri ödenmesinde kullanıldığını ve böylece kaldıraç oranının düşürüldüğünü açıkladı. Musk'ın şirketlerinde 420 milyar dolarlık değer kaybı Fonun portföy değişiklikleri, Elon Musk'ın şirketlerinin piyasalarda sert satış baskısıyla karşılaştığı bir döneme denk geldi. ABD ara seçimlerinin ardından artan siyasi ve düzenleyici risk endişeleriyle SpaceX hisseleri perşembe günü yaklaşık yüzde 9, Tesla hisseleri ise yüzde 11 değer kaybetti. İki şirketin toplam piyasa değerindeki azalma, salı günkü kapanışa kıyasla 420 milyar doları aştı. Yatırımcıların, ABD Kongresi'nde Musk'ın şirketlerine yönelik yeni soruşturmalar başlatılabileceği ve daha sıkı düzenlemelerin gündeme gelebileceği ihtimalini fiyatladığı belirtildi.

Fonun 30 Eylül'de sona eren altı aylık dönemde net varlık değeri bazındaki toplam getirisi yüzde 31,5'e ulaştı. Aynı dönemde FTSE All-World Endeksi yüzde 16 getiri sağlarken fonun hisse fiyatındaki yükseliş yüzde 33,8 oldu. SpaceX yatırımı tek başına fonun toplam getirisine yaklaşık 8 puan katkıda bulundu. Şirket ayrıca SpaceX hisselerinin satışından elde edilen gelirin borçların geri ödenmesinde kullanıldığını ve böylece kaldıraç oranının düşürüldüğünü açıkladı. Musk'ın şirketlerinde 420 milyar dolarlık değer kaybı Fonun portföy değişiklikleri, Elon Musk'ın şirketlerinin piyasalarda sert satış baskısıyla karşılaştığı bir döneme denk geldi. ABD ara seçimlerinin ardından artan siyasi ve düzenleyici risk endişeleriyle SpaceX hisseleri perşembe günü yaklaşık yüzde 9, Tesla hisseleri ise yüzde 11 değer kaybetti. İki şirketin toplam piyasa değerindeki azalma, salı günkü kapanışa kıyasla 420 milyar doları aştı. Yatırımcıların, ABD Kongresi'nde Musk'ın şirketlerine yönelik yeni soruşturmalar başlatılabileceği ve daha sıkı düzenlemelerin gündeme gelebileceği ihtimalini fiyatladığı belirtildi.

articles.title: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
articles.summary: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
articles.summaryTr: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.
articles.articleText: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services. Nigeria’s central bank has introduced new licensing and reserve requirements for cryptocurrency companies, tightening oversight of stablecoins and digital asset payment services in one of Africa’s largest crypto markets. The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) issued the Regulations for the Operations of Non-Security Virtual Assets on Thursday, establishing rules for stablecoin issuers, crypto payment providers, exchanges, custodians and other covered service providers. The regulations took effect immediately, though existing operators have 180 days to apply for licenses or authorizations. The CBN said the framework aims to support responsible innovation while protecting consumers and financial stability. The move follows President Bola Tinubu’s July executive order, which sought to coordinate crypto oversight among Nigerian authorities without changing their existing powers. Stablecoin issuers face new capital and reserve rules Under the new regulations, stablecoin issuers must fully back their tokens with reserve assets and maintain an additional buffer equal to at least 2% of their value. At least 40% of reserves must consist of cash or qualifying highly liquid assets. The rules also set minimum paid-up capital of 10 billion naira ($7.4 million) for naira-backed issuers and 15 billion naira ($11.1 million) for foreign currency-backed stablecoin issuers. Additionally, companies providing payment-related crypto services, including exchange and custody services, must maintain minimum paid-up capital of 1 billion naira ($742,000). The regulations also prohibit stablecoins that rely primarily on algorithms rather than eligible reserves to maintain their value, along with tokens that lack enforceable redemption rights. Nigeria’s crypto crackdown enters a new phase Nigeria has taken a restrictive approach to crypto trading, previously limiting banking access for exchanges and seeking to restrict peer-to-peer trading using local currency. The country drew international attention in the crypto industry over its dispute with Binance, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Binance discontinued its Nigerian naira services in March 2024 amid government scrutiny of crypto trading and allegations of currency manipulation. Nigerian authorities also detained Binance executive Tigran Gambaryan for nearly eight months before dropping money laundering charges against him in October 2024. More recently, Nigeria’s revenue agency introduced crypto tax collection rules for digital asset platforms and peer-to-peer marketplaces in August 2026. articles.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
