articles.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
articles.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, Binance’s $6.3 billion security incident has left unanswered questions about how the exchange managed its hot wallets and limited the amount attackers could access, exchanges moved to reassure customers about their cold storage reserves following Binance’s hack, and Bitcoin plunged below $76,000 as US stocks erased gains made after the midterm elections. Binance’s $6.3B hack leaves questions over hot wallet safeguards Binance’s $6.3 billion security incident has left unanswered questions about how the exchange managed its hot wallets and limited the amount attackers could access. Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said on Oct. 30 that the attack affected the exchange’s own hot wallet. Most customer assets were held in offline cold storage and moved to hot wallets only when users requested withdrawals. Wallet balances offer only a partial picture of an exchange’s exposure to an attack. Public blockchain records can show funds moving but cannot establish the internal controls governing those transfers, CertiK analyst Jonathan Riss told Cointelegraph. In its initial report Tuesday, Binance said attackers accessed an internal wallet-signing service to move funds outside its normal withdrawal process. Binance said some technical details would remain confidential to prevent further attacks. Crypto exchanges tout cold storage ratios after Binance attack Crypto exchanges were quick to reassure users following the attack on Binance’s hot wallet infrastructure last week, with several companies disclosing how they divide assets between cold storage and internet-connected hot wallets this week. Crypto exchange Gate on Thursday launched a “Proof of Security” (PoSEC) framework, reporting that 88.26% of its total assets were in cold storage and 11.74% in hot wallets. It claims its cold storage could cover 104.58% of customer assets even if its hot wallets were completely drained. “By publicly disclosing the distribution of assets between platform cold storage and hot wallets, PoSEC provides visibility into asset storage structures and their ability to cover potential losses under extreme scenarios,” Gate said. It noted the data is still undergoing independent review by a third-party audit firm. Threat actors attacked Binance’s hot-wallet infrastructure last week, stealing approximately $6.36 billion, most of it in about 20 minutes, according to TRM Labs. Binance CEO Richard Teng said the “vast majority” of user assets are held in cold wallets, but the company has not provided a precise split. Bitcoin crashes 6% to 7-week low as US stocks erase election gains Bitcoin (BTC) fell below $76,000 on Thursday as risk assets abruptly reversed their US midterm elections rally. After making swift gains on the back of a Democrat sweep of the US House of Representatives and Senate, equities saw sharp selling on Thursday as traders rotated out of tech. Crypto markets liquidated nearly $500 million in positioning in the first hour of the US trading session, per data from CoinGlass, with 24-hour total liquidations nearing $850 million. Now targeting $76,000, BTC/USD approached the bottom of its one-month trading range. The pair risked losing support at the 50-week simple moving average (SMA), currently at $75,733. In his latest analysis, crypto trader Rekt Capital noted that Bitcoin was repeating behavior from May, when a period of rangebound moves around $80,000 subsequently gave way to a breakdown and new macro lows of $57,000 in late June.

articles.title: Ethereum devs won’t fork Glamsterdam on Hoodi until smart contract risks resolved
articles.summary: Ethereum developers are investigating concerns tied to eight smart contract invariants tied to Glamsterdam’s EIP-8037 and EIP-8038.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Ethereum devs won’t fork Glamsterdam on Hoodi until smart contract risks resolved
articles.summaryTr: Ethereum developers are investigating concerns tied to eight smart contract invariants tied to Glamsterdam’s EIP-8037 and EIP-8038.
articles.articleText: Ethereum devs won’t fork Glamsterdam on Hoodi until smart contract risks resolved Ethereum developers are investigating concerns tied to eight smart contract invariants tied to Glamsterdam’s EIP-8037 and EIP-8038. Ethereum core developers delayed the Glamsterdam upgrade’s implementation on the Hoodi testnet until security concerns tied to eight smart contract invariants are resolved. Some existing Ethereum projects rely on assumptions that certain operations would cost a specific amount of gas, which would be invalidated by Glamsterdam’s EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 because they change how gas is charged for certain operations, the Ethereum Foundation said in a Friday blog post. The decision followed an Oct. 13 report from smart contract auditor ChainSecurity, which found that the two Ethereum Improvement Proposals (EIPs) could break smart contracts that rely on fixed gas-related assumptions when external calls fail. Delaying the Hoodi testnet fork gives developers more time to identify potential smart contract issues and determine whether changes are needed before Glamsterdam progresses toward mainnet deployment. The Hoodi fork will not proceed until the issues are resolved, added the Ethereum Foundation’s post. Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade went live on the Sepolia testnet on Oct. 6, in one of its final major rehearsals. The upgrade aims to advance Ethereum’s layer-1 scaling roadmap with enshrined proposer-builder separation, block-level access lists and changes to gas pricing that better reflect the cost of execution, the Ethereum Foundation announced in a Sept. 28 blog post. articles.title: Solana’s Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report
articles.summary: Solana’s promotional campaigns through domestic entities allegedly violated China’s crypto-related restrictions, an unidentified PBOC official told China’s Financial News.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Solana’s Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report
articles.summaryTr: Solana’s promotional campaigns through domestic entities allegedly violated China’s crypto-related restrictions, an unidentified PBOC official told China’s Financial News.
articles.articleText: Solana’s Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report Solana’s promotional campaigns through domestic entities allegedly violated China’s crypto-related restrictions, an unidentified PBOC official told China’s Financial News. Chinese authorities halted the Solana Accelerate event in Shanghai over alleged unauthorized promotional activities involving domestic entities, China’s state-backed Financial News reported on Friday. The outlet cited an unidentified official from a department of the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), who said Solana had promoted its brand through domestic entities, including by placing advertisements on a building in Shanghai’s Lujiazui financial district. The official also claimed that Solana provides technical services supporting the issuance and trading of cryptocurrencies, which he described as illegal financial activities under Chinese regulations. It marked the second reported disruption of a Solana event in mainland China in the past two years, highlighting how the country’s restrictions extend beyond digital asset trading. An October 2025 Solana event in Shenzhen was also cut short over venue capacity and public-safety concerns, according to an X announcement by Solana’s Chinese-speaking community. In an Oct. 16 X post, Solana Foundation president Lily Liu said organizers postponed the Shanghai event to “comply with local requirements” after an event registration unexpectedly quadrupled, exceeding the event cap pre-registered with local authorities. In a February notice, the PBOC and several other agencies doubled down on crypto-related restrictions and included a new ban on the unauthorized issuance of yuan-pegged stablecoins. Related: Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet, targets 99% faster finality

articles.title: Binance hackers had 8 weeks of access before $6.3B exploit, Security Alliance estimates
articles.summary: The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Binance hackers had 8 weeks of access before $6.3B exploit, Security Alliance estimates
articles.summaryTr: The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack.
articles.articleText: Binance hackers had 8 weeks of access before $6.3B exploit, Security Alliance estimates The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack. Non-profit cybersecurity organization Security Alliance (SEAL) estimates that the North Korea-linked TraderTraitor gained access to Binance’s systems about eight weeks before the $6.3 billion exploit on Oct. 29. The hacking group gained access to Binance’s systems sometime in September, wrote SEAL in a Thursday report, adding that threat actors can navigate these systems with a “high degree of stealth over prolonged periods of time” after initial intrusion. SEAL identified at least four “front companies” associated with TraderTraitor’s fake recruitment campaigns in 2026, including citalab.net, citalab.com, bitfit.io and oddium.io. The cybersecurity organization’s analysis pointed to similar multi-stage intrusion patterns in other high-profile crypto hacks. It estimated that attackers had about six weeks of access before the $388 million Bitget hack, six weeks of access to LayerZero before the vulnerability that led to the $293 million Kelp DAO exploit and about three weeks before conducting the $24 million AFX exploit. Cointelegraph contacted Binance for comment on the estimates but did not receive a response by publication. Binance attributed the $6.3 billion hack to a fake job interview that enabled hackers to compromise an employee device and steal credentials to breach the exchange’s wallet infrastructure. Binance traced the attack campaign back to June, when a separate employee’s device was compromised. The exchange detected the incident and replaced the device, but said that attackers had already gathered information about its team and wallet infrastructure, according to a Tuesday X post. The US Federal Bureau of Investigation attributed the attack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor, in a Saturday report. Kim Yo Jong, sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, dismissed the accusations. Related: Binance hack may be ‘temporary setback’ for crypto, Grayscale’s Pandl says

articles.articleText: What to know about the presidential wiretapping scandal rocking Indonesia - Published Authorities are investigating possible treason in Indonesia after a bombshell announcement this week that President Prabowo Subianto's phone conversations might have been spied on. Several senior figures of Prabowo's administration have been embroiled in the wiretapping scandal, including his chief of staff Listyo Sigit Prabowo - who is not related to the president despite his name. It is unfolding against what many have interpreted as a widening rift between Prabowo and his predecessor, Joko Widodo - otherwise know as Jokowi - who had thrown his support behind Prabowo's 2024 presidential campaign. "Listyo's position, as we know, is actually very close to Jokowi," Made Supriatma, a visiting fellow at Singapore's ISEAS-Yusof Ishak Institute, told BBC Indonesian. "So now it's practically said that they're going their separate ways." What happened? Listyo Sigit Prabowo, the president's chief of staff, was arrested on Tuesday along with two senior police officers for allegedly wiretapping President Prabowo. The three men are suspected of keying phone numbers, including Prabowo's, into the police's official electronic surveillance system - which allows authorities to intercept communications - without following proper procedures, such as obtaining an investigation warrant or case report. Authorities say the operation was discovered last week after a tip-off from a police officer. But they believe the alleged wiretapping stretches back to 2025, when Listyo was serving as the national police chief. This could amount to treason, as it involved "sensitive information" that could "endanger the interests and sovereignty of the nation", a spokesperson for the president told reporters on Wednesday. In Indonesia, treason is punishable by life imprisonment or even the death penalty - though the country has not executed anyone in a decade. The spokesperson said the motive behind the alleged wiretapping remained unclear. It was not just President Prabowo who was targeted in the alleged wiretapping operation, either. Other targets included politicians, journalists, NGO representatives and businesspeople, authorities said. On Thursday evening, police named a fourth suspect: Slamet Uliandi, from the national police criminal investigation unit. But he was not detained due to his ill health after suffering a stroke, according to authorities. Listyo, who was appointed the president's chief of staff last month, was sacked from his new position shortly after his arrest. This is not the first wiretapping scandal to have involved Indonesia's leaders. In 2014, several wiretapping devices were discovered at Jokowi's official residence when he was the governor of Jakarta. Former president Megawati Soekarnoputri claimed in 2024 that she had avoided using her personal mobile phone number because she was the target of wiretapping. Indonesia's police chief Suyudi Ario Seto told reporters on Thursday that the probe into wiretapping was "purely law enforcement and has nothing to do with rivalries or anything else". But many see it as the latest blow in a disintegrating alliance between President Prabowo and former president Jokowi, who led the country from 2014 to 2024. Prabowo vs Jokowi Jokowi had thrown his support behind Prabowo in the lead-up to the 2024 presidential election, as part of an alliance that ultimately propelled Prabowo to become Indonesia's next leader. Riding to victory with him was Gibran Rakabuming Raka, Jokowi's eldest son, who became Indonesia's vice president. Two years on, that alliance appears to be fracturing - even if neither party has confirmed the rift. Since taking the presidency, Prabowo has shown little interest in pushing ahead with Jokowi's legacy project: the construction of Nusantara, a new capital. Instead, he has focused much of the state's resources on his own flagship programme to provide free school meals across the country. In a series of personnel reshuffles over the past year, Prabowo has also shifted many of Jokowi's allies into new roles, including long-serving finance minister Sri Mulyani Indrawati. Meanwhile, uncertainty also looms over Gibran, Jokowi's son, who is mired in a growing controversy over the validity of his high school credentials, a pre-requisite to run for vice presidency. He now faces calls to be disqualified from his job, on the grounds that he should not have been eligible as a candidate. The wiretapping scandal and subsequent arrest of Listyo - who rose to the top of the police force in Jokowi's administration, and is seen as one of the ex-president's longtime allies - is now adding to the tensions between Prabowo and Jokowi. When asked about the wiretapping incident after the court session on Thursday, Jokowi told reporters that "we should all respect the ongoing legal process". This latest scandal comes during a particularly turbulent period in Prabowo's presidency. His flagship free school meals programme is struggling for funding, parts of Indonesia have recently battled the country's worst wildfires in a decade, and the national stock market faces crisis amid allegations of widespread market manipulation. Experts, meanwhile, say all this has distracted from the more pressing challenges that Indonesians are facing on the ground - from economic uncertainties to environmental pollution. In recent months, protesters have taken to the streets to pressure the government on a range of issues such as toxic wildfire haze, corruption, and cost-of-living woes. "It's like we're living in a country on autopilot," Nicky Fahrizal, a researcher at the Centre for Strategic and International Studies in Indonesia, told BBC Indonesian. "Because the way the government operates proves that it's not the people's interests that are being pursued, but rather the interests of individual groups."

articles.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements
articles.articleText: Release Number 9322-26 CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission’s Division of Clearing and Risk today issued a no-action letter addressing whether derivatives clearing organizations may use trust companies to conduct daily settlements with clearing members. According to the letter, a derivatives clearing organization may use a trust company for daily settlements if it treats the trust company as it would a settlement bank under applicable CFTC requirements. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

articles.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. articles.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
articles.articleText: Release Number 9315-26 CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced today it has filed a lawsuit against Utah to block the state’s efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets using state laws. The lawsuit follows Utah’s decision to file civil enforcement actions in state court against CFTC-regulated markets and other businesses. Utah’s effort to restrict the functioning of CFTC-registered exchanges obstructs Congress’s decision to federally preempt state law. “Utah seeks to shut down prediction markets across a wide variety of markets,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Event contracts do not just serve hedging and investment purposes—they also provide the public with information about the outcome of future events. Congress entrusted the CFTC to be the federal regulator with sole responsibility to oversee these markets. As I’ve said before, the CFTC has the expertise and responsibility to defend its exclusive jurisdiction over commodity derivatives, and that’s exactly what we’ll do.” This action reflects the CFTC’s firm commitment to maintaining its exclusive jurisdiction over CFTC-registered prediction markets. The CFTC continues to draw a clear line: if a state challenges the lawful operation of a derivatives exchange, the Commission will protect federal sovereign interests. The Commission has also initiated legal proceedings against nine other states and has submitted briefs in four federal courts of appeal and one state supreme court. -CFTC-

news.articleText: Enka İnşaat'ın (ENKAI) kârı yüzde 17 geriledi! 3. çeyrek bilançosu beklenti altında kaldı - Enka İnşaat, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 3,42 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin 9 aylık net kârı yıllık yüzde 17 düşüşle 21,87 milyar TL'ye gerilerken, çeyreklik sonuçlar piyasa beklentisini karşılayamadı. Enka İnşaat ve Sanayi A.Ş. (ENKAI), 2026 yılının üçüncü çeyreğine ilişkin finansal sonuçlarını Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımladı. Şirket, temmuz-eylül döneminde 3 milyar 422 milyon 270 bin TL net kâr elde etti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Böylece Enka'nın 2026 yılının ilk dokuz ayındaki toplam net kârı 21 milyar 869 milyon 395 bin TL oldu. Şirketin geçen yılın aynı döneminde açıkladığı 26,28 milyar TL'lik net kârla karşılaştırıldığında, yıllık bazda yüzde 17 düşüş kaydedildi. Kâr beklentilerin altında kaldı Matriks Haber tarafından gerçekleştirilen bilanço anketine 8 aracı kurum katıldı. Ankete göre Enka İnşaat için üçüncü çeyrek ortalama net kâr beklentisi 5 milyar 129 milyon TL, medyan beklenti ise 4 milyar 944 milyon 200 bin TL seviyesindeydi. Şirketin açıkladığı 3,42 milyar TL'lik net kâr, hem ortalama hem de medyan beklentinin altında gerçekleşti. Böylece Enka, üçüncü çeyrek bilançosunda piyasa tahminlerini karşılayamadı. Satışlar yüzde 20 artarken faaliyet kârı geriledi Enka İnşaat'ın 2026 yılının ilk dokuz ayında elde ettiği hasılat, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 108,97 milyar TL'den 130,22 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Böylece satış gelirleri yıllık yüzde 20 artış gösterdi. Buna karşın esas faaliyet kârı 20,66 milyar TL'den 18,24 milyar TL'ye gerileyerek yüzde 12 düşüş kaydetti. FAVÖK de geçen yılki 23,99 milyar TL seviyesinden 23,80 milyar TL'ye indi. Varlıklar ve özkaynaklar yükseldi Enka'nın toplam varlıkları 2025 yıl sonundaki 493,06 milyar TL seviyesinden 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreği itibarıyla 565,13 milyar TL'ye çıktı. Aynı dönemde toplam borçlar 113,52 milyar TL'den 126,29 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Şirketin özkaynakları ise 373,22 milyar TL'den 431,78 milyar TL'ye ulaştı. Özkaynaklarda çeyreklik dönemde yüzde 5 artış kaydedildi. Enka İnşaat'ın 2026 üçüncü çeyrek bilançosu Şirketin piyasa çarpanlarında F/K oranı 15,27, PD/DD oranı 1,12 olarak açıklandı. Enka İnşaat'ın piyasa değeri ise 485,10 milyar TL seviyesinde bulunuyor.

news.title: Could the US midterms put a pin in the AI bubble?
news.summary: Fears of more AI regulation appear to have sparked fear among investors, but concerns about the industry have been growing for some time.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Could the US midterms put a pin in the AI bubble?
news.summaryTr: Fears of more AI regulation appear to have sparked fear among investors, but concerns about the industry have been growing for some time.
news.articleText: Could the US midterms put a pin in the AI bubble? - Published Is the artificial intelligence (AI) gold rush coming to an end, or is this simply a reality check? That's the question which is hanging over investors, and which has prompted steep falls on the world's stock markets. The sell-off in the US on Thursday was most dramatic on the Nasdaq, home to tech industry titans such as Alphabet, Nvidia, Meta and Apple. It followed sweeping gains by the Democrats in this week's mid-term elections in the US, which have given the party full control of Congress. A number of leading Democrats campaigned against the unhindered expansion of data centres, which have underpinned the growth of artificial intelligence. Fears this will lead to more regulation of AI appear to have sparked fear among investors. But concerns about the industry's prospects have been growing for some time. AI boom The release of Chat GPT by Open AI in late 2022 is widely seen as having generated massive public and corporate interest in the practical uses of AI. It also sparked a modern-day gold rush. Investors flocked to put their money into companies producing computer chips and networking infrastructure, building data centres and providing the energy to power them, as well as developing the AI itself. The value of tech companies soared. The boom continued into this year. Investments in AI are expected to reach $1trillion in 2026 alone according to research by Goldman Sachs. The sector has scooped up so much available cash that other industries have seen their own borrowing costs increase as a result. But investors want returns, and in recent months concerns have been growing about whether the AI boom can produce the expected riches. Those worries have emerged at a time when public comments from AI researchers casting doubt over the safety of AI - even suggesting it could represent an existential threat to humanity - have been grabbing headlines and fuelling speculation that a clampdown could lie ahead. Democrat opposition While the Trump administration has been all-in on AI, or "super intelligence" as the president likes to call it, many leading Democrats have tapped into grassroots concerns about the expansion of data centres and their impact on local communities. These were largely focused on the facilities' high consumption of water and electricity, which many feared would push up their household bills – as well as the noise, use of land, and general disruption associated with them. A Gallup poll published in May showed 71% of Americans would oppose the building of a data centre in their community. The figure for a nuclear power station was 53%. James Talarico, who won the Senate race in once staunchly Republican Texas, was one of those to tap into this scepticism. "While we want to protect America's leadership in artificial intelligence, we are still grappling with how it will affect everything from how we work to how our children learn," he said. "We must protect Americans and establish clear, consistent laws for businesses." With control of both houses of Congress, Democrats are now expected to challenge the president's technology agenda more vigorously, while introducing legislation which could curb the expansion of the industry. Texas' Democratic governor-elect Gina Hinojosa campaigned against data centres, pledging a moratorium on the construction of new facilities. Hinojosa's win could present opposition to tech multi-billionaire Elon Musk, who has moved large parts of SpaceX and Tesla's operations to the state, for years a Republican stronghold. The Tesla boss had spent nearly $450m to back Republican campaigns in the midterms. Where next for stocks? As the co-founder of the British-based technology firm Arm Holdings, Tudor Brown, points out, "stock values are based on future earnings not present earnings". If the rewards are not likely to be as great as expected, some investors will choose to sell up. The falls seen on stock markets over the past 24 hours would appear to have been triggered by the mid-term results. But concerns that tech firms have become overvalued were being expressed long before the elections. The question now is whether this is simply the removal of froth from an over-exuberant market, or a sign that the AI rush is a bubble about to burst, with much wider consequences. Nandini Roy Choudhury of Future Market Insights thinks investors will assess whether the political shift could result in restrictions on data centre construction, energy consumption and the deployment of AI technology. She adds there is unlikely to be an immediate widespread recovery in tech stocks as traders are likely to be more selective, favouring firms with stronger balance sheets. Brown thinks the impact will be limited. Share valuations, he thinks, were inflated by expectations of "almost infinite AI growth", which have been followed by "a bit of a panic". "There is a natural floor to this", he says. "After that it will reflect I think that actually there's still a lot of money being made in these companies".

A number of leading Democrats campaigned against the unhindered expansion of data centres, which have underpinned the growth of artificial intelligence. Fears this will lead to more regulation of AI appear to have sparked fear among investors. But concerns about the industry's prospects have been growing for some time. AI boom The release of Chat GPT by Open AI in late 2022 is widely seen as having generated massive public and corporate interest in the practical uses of AI. It also sparked a modern-day gold rush. Investors flocked to put their money into companies producing computer chips and networking infrastructure, building data centres and providing the energy to power them, as well as developing the AI itself. The value of tech companies soared. The boom continued into this year. Investments in AI are expected to reach $1trillion in 2026 alone according to research by Goldman Sachs. The sector has scooped up so much available cash that other industries have seen their own borrowing costs increase as a result. But investors want returns, and in recent months concerns have been growing about whether the AI boom can produce the expected riches. Those worries have emerged at a time when public comments from AI researchers casting doubt over the safety of AI - even suggesting it could represent an existential threat to humanity - have been grabbing headlines and fuelling speculation that a clampdown could lie ahead. Democrat opposition While the Trump administration has been all-in on AI, or "super intelligence" as the president likes to call it, many leading Democrats have tapped into grassroots concerns about the expansion of data centres and their impact on local communities. These were largely focused on the facilities' high consumption of water and electricity, which many feared would push up their household bills – as well as the noise, use of land, and general disruption associated with them. A Gallup poll published in May showed 71% of Americans would oppose the building of a data centre in their community. The figure for a nuclear power station was 53%. James Talarico, who won the Senate race in once staunchly Republican Texas, was one of those to tap into this scepticism. "While we want to protect America's leadership in artificial intelligence, we are still grappling with how it will affect everything from how we work to how our children learn," he said. "We must protect Americans and establish clear, consistent laws for businesses." With control of both houses of Congress, Democrats are now expected to challenge the president's technology agenda more vigorously, while introducing legislation which could curb the expansion of the industry. Texas' Democratic governor-elect Gina Hinojosa campaigned against data centres, pledging a moratorium on the construction of new facilities. Hinojosa's win could present opposition to tech multi-billionaire Elon Musk, who has moved large parts of SpaceX and Tesla's operations to the state, for years a Republican stronghold. The Tesla boss had spent nearly $450m to back Republican campaigns in the midterms. Where next for stocks? As the co-founder of the British-based technology firm Arm Holdings, Tudor Brown, points out, "stock values are based on future earnings not present earnings". If the rewards are not likely to be as great as expected, some investors will choose to sell up. The falls seen on stock markets over the past 24 hours would appear to have been triggered by the mid-term results. But concerns that tech firms have become overvalued were being expressed long before the elections. The question now is whether this is simply the removal of froth from an over-exuberant market, or a sign that the AI rush is a bubble about to burst, with much wider consequences. Nandini Roy Choudhury of Future Market Insights thinks investors will assess whether the political shift could result in restrictions on data centre construction, energy consumption and the deployment of AI technology. She adds there is unlikely to be an immediate widespread recovery in tech stocks as traders are likely to be more selective, favouring firms with stronger balance sheets. Brown thinks the impact will be limited. Share valuations, he thinks, were inflated by expectations of "almost infinite AI growth", which have been followed by "a bit of a panic". "There is a natural floor to this", he says. "After that it will reflect I think that actually there's still a lot of money being made in these companies".

news.articleText: Karsan'da (KARSN) satış gelirleri arttı ama... İşte 3. çeyrek bilançosunun detayları - Karsan Otomotiv, 2026'nın ilk dokuz ayında 579,5 milyon TL net zarar açıkladı. Şirketin hasılatı yıllık yüzde 28 artarken esas faaliyet kârı yüzde 62 geriledi. Karsan Otomotiv (KARSN), 2026 yılının üçüncü çeyreğine ilişkin finansal sonuçlarını Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımladı. Şirket, 1 Ocak-30 Eylül 2026 döneminde 579 milyon 475 bin TL net zarar kaydetti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Karsan'ın geçen yılın aynı döneminde açıkladığı 877 milyon 318 bin TL'lik zarara kıyasla net zararını azalttığı görüldü. Buna karşın şirketin operasyonel kârlılığındaki gerileme dikkat çekti. Satış gelirleri yüzde 28 yükseldi Karsan'ın 2026 yılının ilk dokuz ayında elde ettiği hasılat, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 10,44 milyar TL'den 13,35 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Böylece şirketin satış gelirleri yıllık bazda yüzde 28 artış gösterdi. Ancak satışlardaki büyüme esas faaliyet kârına aynı ölçüde yansımadı. Şirketin esas faaliyet kârı, 1,06 milyar TL'den 404,8 milyon TL'ye gerileyerek yaklaşık yüzde 62 düşüş kaydetti. FAVÖK ise geçen yılın ilk dokuz ayındaki 1,06 milyar TL seviyesinden 1,10 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Varlıklar ve özkaynaklarda gerileme Karsan'ın toplam varlıkları 2025 yıl sonundaki 25,84 milyar TL seviyesinden 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreği itibarıyla 20,76 milyar TL'ye geriledi. Aynı dönemde toplam borçlar 16,85 milyar TL'den 12,41 milyar TL'ye indi. Şirketin özkaynakları ise 8,99 milyar TL'den 8,35 milyar TL'ye düşüş gösterdi. Özkaynaklardaki gerileme çeyreklik dönemde yüzde 4 olarak kaydedildi. Karsan'ın 2026 üçüncü çeyrek bilançosu Şirketin piyasa çarpanlarında F/K oranı 13,57, PD/DD oranı 0,85 olarak açıklandı. Karsan'ın piyasa değeri ise 7,10 milyar TL seviyesinde bulunuyor.

news.titleTr: SPK'dan kapalı fonlar için açıklama: İşleme açılma kararını portföy şirketleri verecek
news.summaryTr: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), TEFAS ve TEFAS dışı kanallarda alım satıma kapatılan fonların yeniden işleme açılmasına ilişkin yanlış bilgilendirmelere karşı uyarıda bulundu.
news.articleText: SPK'dan kapalı fonlar için açıklama: İşleme açılma kararını portföy şirketleri verecek - Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), TEFAS ve TEFAS dışı kanallarda alım satıma kapatılan fonların yeniden işleme açılmasına ilişkin yanlış bilgilendirmelere karşı uyarıda bulundu. - A1 Capital, Bulls ve Pardus Portföy'ün kapalı fonları yeniden işleme açabilmesi için Ziraat Bankası üzerinden SPK'ya başvurması gerekiyor. Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), alım satıma kapatılan yatırım fonlarının yeniden işleme açılmasına ilişkin kamuoyunda yer alan bazı haber ve sosyal medya paylaşımlarının yanlış yönlendirmelere yol açtığını bildirdi. SPK'dan kapalı fonlar için yeni açıklama CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle SPK'nın 6 Kasım 2026 tarihli duyurusunda, 17 Eylül 2026 tarihli Kurul kararlarıyla A1 Capital, Atlas, Bulls, Hedef, Pardus, Pusula ve Tera Portföy Yönetimi şirketlerinin kurucusu olduğu ve katılma payları TEFAS'ta işlem gören tüm yatırım fonlarının hem TEFAS'ta hem de TEFAS dışı dağıtım kanallarında alım satıma kapatıldığı hatırlatıldı. Üç portföy şirketinin fonlarında tasfiye süreci öncelikli 30 Eylül 2026 tarihli ve 2026/67 sayılı SPK Bülteni'nde A1 Capital, Bulls ve Pardus Portföy Yönetimi'nin kurucusu olduğu fonların tasfiye işlemlerine öncelikli olarak başlanacağı açıklanmıştı. Duyuruya göre bu fonların tasfiye süreci tamamlandıktan sonra, aynı şirketlerin tasfiye kapsamında bulunmayan ancak alım satıma kapatılmış diğer fonları yeniden işleme açılabilecek. Fonların açılma tarihini şirketler belirleyecek SPK, kapalı fonların yeniden işleme açılmasının otomatik olarak gerçekleşmeyeceğinin altını çizdi. Fonların hangi tarihte ve hangi alım satım esaslarıyla işleme açılacağına; portföy yapısı, likidite, piyasa koşulları ve yatırımcıların menfaatleri dikkate alınarak ilgili portföy yönetim şirketleri karar verecek. Bu kapsamda A1 Capital, Bulls ve Pardus Portföy Yönetimi şirketlerinin öncelikle Ziraat Bankası'na başvuruda bulunması gerekiyor. Başvuruların banka tarafından SPK'ya iletilmesinin ardından süreç Kurul nezdinde ilerleyecek. SPK'nın açıklaması, kapalı fonların tamamının aynı anda veya belirli bir tarihte yeniden işleme açılacağı anlamına gelmiyor. Yeniden açılma süreci, ilgili şirketlerin başvuruları ve fonların koşulları çerçevesinde şekillenecek.

news.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
news.summary: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
news.summaryTr: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.
news.articleText: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say - Published A young girl and an 18-year-old man have died after a bus crashed in eastern France, local authorities have said. The bus was travelling between Lyon and Bourg-en-Bresse when it crashed at around 07:00 local time on Friday in the town of Lent, about 34 miles (55km) from the border with Switzerland. The bus was carrying 43 passengers, including 15 children, the Bourg-en-Bresse prosecutor's office said. Three people are in a critical condition and at least 13 others have sustained minor injuries. French President Emmanuel Macron said his thoughts were with the victims, the injured, and their families. In a post on X, he said the nation stood by their side and thanked the rescue teams involved. The town's mayor Yves Cristin told French media the bus "left the road and hit a tree in the ditch". The two people killed have been identified by authorities. However, there have been differing reports as to the age of the girl. The prosecutor's office said it was "opening an investigation into the incident, on charges of road homicide and aggravated road traffic injuries". The driver has been taken to hospital after sustaining injuries and has not yet been questioned by police. French Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot said initial tests indicated there were no traces of alcohol or drugs in his blood. Photos circulating in French media show a blue and white bus tilted in what appears to be a ditch on the roadside. Trees line the side of the road. The front of the bus appears to be heavily damaged. Local mayor Cristin told BFM TV: "I arrived minutes after the accident and people were in shock. "The side of the bus was torn off, and clearly, the people who were on that side must have been seriously injured." Addressing weather conditions at the time of the crash, the mayor told Le Figaro "there was a bit of fog, the road was wet" but there were "no major difficulties". Speaking to the same paper, Fabrice Pannekoucke, head of the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region, said: "At this stage, there are no particular explanations or interpretations that can be given." Tabarot said the bus did not operate "exclusively on school routes" but that there were "many schoolchildren on board". French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said the accident was tragic, and thanked the firefighters, medical teams and police who attended the scene. Earlier, French Education Minister Édouard Geffray said it was "always difficult when our children are victims of accidents of this nature". Emergency services were at the scene and medical helicopters were deployed to take victims with serious injuries to a specialised hospital. More than 100 firefighters and 50 gendarmes were also at the scene. The local town hall was opened to provide shelter and coordinate with emergency services, the local mayor said. news.articleText: Enerji devi Tüpraş'tan (TUPRS) beklentileri aşan bilanço: İşte detaylar! - Tüpraş, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 68,68 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin 9 aylık kârı yıllık yüzde 328 artışla 121,3 milyar TL'ye yükselirken, sonuçlar piyasa beklentilerinin üzerinde gerçekleşti. Tüpraş (TUPRS), 2026 yılının üçüncü çeyreğine ilişkin finansal sonuçlarını açıkladı. Şirket, temmuz-eylül döneminde 68 milyar 676 milyon 738 bin TL net dönem kârı elde etti. Böylece yılın ilk dokuz ayındaki toplam net kâr 121 milyar 300 milyon 937 bin TL'ye ulaştı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Tüpraş'ın 2025 yılının aynı döneminde açıkladığı 28,31 milyar TL'lik net kâr dikkate alındığında, şirketin 9 aylık kârı yıllık bazda yüzde 328 artış gösterdi. Kâr beklentilerin üzerinde gerçekleşti Matriks Haber tarafından gerçekleştirilen bilanço anketine 11 aracı kurum katıldı. Ankete göre Tüpraş için üçüncü çeyrek ortalama net kâr beklentisi 60 milyar 570 milyon 600 bin TL, medyan beklenti ise 60 milyar 105 milyon TL seviyesindeydi. Şirketin açıkladığı 68,68 milyar TL'lik net kâr, hem ortalama hem de medyan beklentiyi geride bıraktı. news.title: PM tells firms to publish salaries in job adverts ahead of new law
news.summary: The government argues the change will help jobseekers and could help to prevent pay discrimination.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: PM tells firms to publish salaries in job adverts ahead of new law
news.summaryTr: The government argues the change will help jobseekers and could help to prevent pay discrimination.
news.articleText: PM tells firms to publish salaries in job adverts ahead of new law - Published Businesses should publish salaries in job adverts now, Prime Minister Andy Burnham is telling firms, rather than wait for a new law to come in that will force them to do so. The government is planning to make pay details compulsory in adverts, with legislation on the issue being brought forward "as soon as possible". It argues the change will help jobseekers, particularly those applying for their first job, and could help prevent pay discrimination. However, one industry group said setting pay was a complex process and regulating adverts was not always suitable. It comes a week after the UK's equality watchdog said employees should legally be able to find out what their colleagues are earning. Burnham said the current system felt "weighted against the applicant" and the changes were aimed at "tilting the scales back". "It can be quite soul destroying for young people these days, applying for jobs when the salary is not listed but sometimes they're not getting a reply," he told the BBC. The prime minister added that publishing salaries in adverts was also important for closing the gender pay gap. He was also challenged over whether MPs should be disclosing salaries when advertising for staff in their offices. A number of politicians are currently advertising for roles without giving an expected salary., external Burnham said: "It would apply completely to them too and the call I'm making today is, before the law changes do it voluntarily because it's the right thing to do." Greater transparency The Cabinet Office launched a consultation into pay and reducing discrimination in the summer, and the government said there had been "overwhelming support" for greater transparency, with 94% of respondents backing the move. "Whether you're a young person starting out or a parent trying to support your family, you should know what a job pays before spending your time and effort applying for it," Burnham said. The government said the move was part of attempts to reduce the nearly one million young people not in education, employment or training - or "Neet" - ahead of the final report of the Milburn Review into youth inactivity, which is due in the coming weeks. Publishing salary details upfront could "expose unjustified differences in pay, give workers greater confidence to challenge discrimination and prevent disagreements over pay escalating into disputes". The proposals are similar to measures being introduced in the European Union., external Employers in Europe will have to disclose the initial pay or range for new roles, which must either be included in a published job advert or shared before an interview. According to data from UK jobs website Adzuna, external, 51% of the adverts on its site in September had salary information, but the proportion has been falling in recent years. Adzuna co-founder Andrew Hunter said being open about pay "should be the norm, not the exception". He added that employers who put a salary on a job advert "attract more applicants, and better-suited ones". 'More complicated' Previous research from the CIPD, external, an industry body for human resources managers, has indicated that the public sector and charities are more likely to reveal pay information that private firms, while pay ranges were more common than specific salaries. But it found not all employers were "fully transparent", with pay ranges sometimes wider than £10,000. CIPD chief executive Neil Carberry said that while, in principle, giving salary details was "a good thing", in practice it was "more complicated". "There isn't always a single fixed figure, and employers will want to set pay based on a candidate's skills, experience and potential." Carberry added the process was complex, saying that drafting job adverts is "best left to good employer practice rather than government regulation". The government has said it will set out further details on what information will be required and how the legislation will be enforced "in due course". Conservative shadow business secretary Julia Lopez said: "At a time when employers are finding it harder and harder to take on staff, Labour have decided to make their lives even more difficult. "It should be up to businesses to decide what information they advertise about job openings, and to decide how to attract the best applicants. "As long as they are not being dishonest, misleading or discriminatory, it should not be a matter for the government." Last week, the Equality and Human Rights Commission (EHRC), said publishing salaries in job adverts would be a "positive step". It also said bosses should be required to respond to questionnaires about colleagues' pay to cut pay discrimination. At present, employers do not have to respond to employee requests for salary information about their co-workers. The EHRC also said employers should be prevented from asking about current salary when offering a job to stop a history of discrimination from continuing. Employers in the UK are currently allowed to ask you how much you get paid in your current role, but applicants are under no obligation to tell them. news.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
news.summary: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
news.summaryTr: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.
news.articleText: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines - Published European airlines have again been hit with a new wave of bomb threats - in the third such incident this week. On Friday multiple flights to and from Lisbon, Rome, Prague and Sofia were targeted and the threats saw three planes escorted by Hungarian fighter jets, authorities said. It also saw a number of high-profile media organisations, including Ireland's public broadcaster RTÉ, evacuated after threats were made against them - although there has been no concrete links between the messages against airlines and the broadcasters yet. The disruption comes after nearly 30 aircraft and several airports across Europe were impacted by bomb threats earlier this week, in what the UK called a "malicious hoax". A Ryanair flight scheduled to leave Lisbon for Rome on Friday was targeted with a threat, the airline said, while at least 11 flights were targeted in the Czech Republic and Bulgaria, according to AFP. France also reported at least four of its flights were targeted by threats, however they all landed safely. No explosives have been found on any planes as of Friday. As airlines were dealing with this latest wave of threats, several media outlets, including RTÉ, were evacuated after similar warnings were made against them. Staff at the Irish Independent newspaper and the Dublin offices of radio stations NewstalkFM and TodayFM, were also advised to leave their buildings and UK broadcaster Sky said it also received a security threat. In a statement, gardaí (Irish police) said they were "aware of a threat made against media organisations here and in Europe". While no link has been established between the threats against airlines and media outlets, the Irish government has warned it is a "likely coordinated campaign of disruption". In a statement, it said: "Hoax threats such as these cause fear, distress and disruption to people going about their daily lives and activities; they achieve no positive purpose whatsoever. It is not known yet who is responsible for these threats, whether it is individuals or a centralised or co-ordinated effort. Irish Prime Minister Micheál Martin described situation as "worrying" and added his government's first priority was the safety of the Irish public. "Yesterday, there appeared to be coordinated efforts to disrupt air travel," he said. Martin told RTÉ it was not yet known if the threats had come from individuals or if it was a "coordinated attack" but said they were being taken seriously. Ireland is scheduled to host two high-profile European Union meetings in Dublin next week. Broadcaster Sky confirmed it had received a security threat, hours after RTÉ had evacuated its building. The broadcaster, which is owned by Comcast, said in a statement read by a presenter on its news channel that the broadcaster had "carried out a security assessment and reported the matter to the relevant authorities". "The safety and security of our colleagues is our primary concern, and we are working closely with authorities to ensure our people and operations remain secure." Friday's disruption comes after the Russian extremist group "Male State", named in this week's hoax bomb threats to Italian airports, denied any link to the false warnings. Replying to the BBC Russian Service, an account on Telegram - one of several linked to the so-called "Male State" and its founder Vladislav Pozdnyakov - mocked any suggestion the group was involved in emailing the threats. "What Male State? Where have you seen it? It hasn't existed for many years," the message on the channel reads. "If tomorrow they sign a [threat] letter, say, from Putin, will you then try to reach our president to ask your stupid question?" - Published2 hours ago - Published19 hours ago

news.articleText: Tesla bir modelin fişini çekme kararı aldı: Fabrikada Cybercab dönemi başlıyor - Tesla, beklentilerin altında kalan Cybertruck satışlarının ardından modelin üretimini 2027'nin ortasından itibaren kademeli olarak sonlandıracak. Teksas'taki fabrikada boşalacak üretim alanı sürücüsüz robotaksi Cybercab'e ayrılacak. Tesla, elektrikli otomobil pazarının en tartışmalı modellerinden Cybertruck için üretimden çekilme kararı aldı. Şirketin CEO'su Elon Musk'ın duyurduğu plana göre aracın üretimi 2027'nin ortasından itibaren kademeli olarak sona erdirilecek. Tesla, Cybertruck'ın üretildiği Teksas'taki Gigafactory tesisinde açılacak kapasiteyi sürücüsüz robotaksi projesi Cybercab için kullanmayı planlıyor. 1 milyon ön sipariş aldı, satış hedefinin gerisinde kaldı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Cybertruck, piyasaya çıkmadan önce 1 milyondan fazla ön sipariş alarak büyük beklenti yaratmıştı. Elon Musk, model için yıllık en az 250 bin adetlik satış hedefi açıklamıştı. Ancak yıllar süren ertelemelerin ardından 2023'te yollara çıkan araç, beklenen ticari başarıyı yakalayamadı. Trapezoid gövde tasarımı ve beklentilerin üzerinde kalan fiyat etiketi, Cybertruck'ın geniş tüketici kitlesine ulaşmasını zorlaştırdı. Cox Automotive verilerine göre model, geçen yıl yaklaşık 20 bin adet satılırken 2026 genelinde teslimatların yaklaşık 16 bin seviyesinde kalması bekleniyor. Tesla Başmühendisi Wes Morrill de aracın dört yıllık serüveninin sona erdiğini doğruladı. Morrill, Cybertruck'ın geliştirme sürecinde Cybercab için önemli bir teknoloji platformu işlevi gördüğünü belirtti. En büyük alıcısı SpaceX oldu Cybertruck'ın son dönemdeki en büyük müşterilerinden biri de Elon Musk'ın diğer şirketi SpaceX oldu. SpaceX'in geçen yıl destek aracı olarak kullanmak üzere 131 milyon dolarlık Cybertruck satın aldığı belirtildi. Tesla'nın yeni odağı robotaksi ve insansı robotlar Cybertruck üretiminin sonlandırılması, Tesla'nın stratejisinde otomobil üretiminden yapay zekâ, otonom sürüş ve robotik teknolojilere doğru yaşanan dönüşümün yeni adımı olarak değerlendiriliyor. Şirket, bu yılın başlarında Model S ve Model X üretimini de Optimus insansı robotuna fabrikada yer açmak amacıyla sonlandırmıştı. news.titleTr: Tesla Kasım 2026 fiyatları açıklandı: İşte Model Y fiyatı ve kampanyalar!
news.summaryTr: Tesla'nın Türkiye'de satışa sunduğu Model Y ailesinin kasım ayı fiyatları belli oldu. Dört farklı versiyonun fiyatı 2,47 milyon TL ile 4,97 milyon TL arasında değişiyor.
news.articleText: Tesla Kasım 2026 fiyatları açıklandı: İşte Model Y fiyatı ve kampanyalar! Tesla'nın Türkiye'de satışa sunduğu Model Y ailesinin kasım ayı fiyatları belli oldu. Dört farklı versiyonun fiyatı 2,47 milyon TL ile 4,97 milyon TL arasında değişiyor. Tesla Model Y'nin başlangıç fiyatı 2 milyon 474 bin TL Tesla Model Y ailesinin Türkiye'deki en ulaşılabilir seçeneği Arkadan Çekiş versiyonu oldu. Tamamen elektrikli SUV, günlük kullanıma yönelik çekiş sistemi ve sade donanım tercihleriyle ailenin giriş modelini oluşturuyor. Tesla'nın Kasım 2026 fiyat listesinde bu versiyonun tavsiye edilen anahtar teslim bedeli 2 milyon 474 bin 985 TL olarak açıklandı. Premium Long Range Arkadan Çekiş 3,9 milyon TL Daha uzun menzil arayan kullanıcıları hedefleyen Premium Long Range Arkadan Çekiş versiyonu, Model Y ailesinde daha üst bir donanım ve fiyat seviyesinde konumlanıyor. Bu yapılandırmada 19 inç Crossflow jantlar, All Black iç mekân ve beş koltuklu oturma düzeni sunuluyor. Modelin kasım ayındaki tavsiye edilen anahtar teslim fiyatı 3 milyon 906 bin TL olarak belirlendi. Premium Long Range Dört Çeker 4,62 milyon TL Model Y'nin dört tekerlekten çekişli Premium Long Range seçeneği, uzun menzil beklentisini dört çeker sisteminin sunduğu çekiş avantajıyla birleştiriyor. Bu versiyonda da 19 inç Crossflow jantlar ve All Black iç mekân tercihleri bulunuyor. Tesla'nın kasım ayı fiyat listesinde modelin anahtar teslim bedeli 4 milyon 620 bin TL seviyesinde yer alıyor. Model Y Performance 4 milyon 966 bin TL Model Y ailesinin en üst fiyatlı seçeneği Performance Dört Çeker oldu. Performans odaklı tasarım ayrıntılarıyla diğer versiyonlardan ayrılan modelde 21 inç Arachnid 2.0 jantlar ve All Black iç mekân sunuluyor. Tesla Model Y Performance'ın Kasım 2026 tavsiye edilen anahtar teslim fiyatı 4 milyon 966 bin 500 TL olarak açıklandı. Full Self-Driving aboneliği aylık 4 bin 990 TL Tesla, Model Y'nin tüm versiyonlarında Full Self-Driving kabiliyetini ücretli aylık abonelik seçeneğiyle sunuyor. Söz konusu özellik için açıklanan aylık abonelik bedeli 4 bin 990 TL. Böylece kullanıcılar araç versiyonundan bağımsız olarak bu opsiyona erişebiliyor. Abonelik bedeli araçların anahtar teslim fiyatlarına dahil değil.

news.title: Emre Belözoğlu Fenerbahçe için imzayı attı: "Hedefimiz şampiyonluk ve kupalar"
news.summary: Fenerbahçe'nin yeni teknik direktörü Emre Belözoğlu için Chobani Stadı'nda imza töreni düzenlendi. Sarı-lacivertli takıma yeniden dönen Belözoğlu, şampiyonluk hedefini vurgulayarak “Fenerbahçe için tutku ve kalite net kriterler” dedi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Emre Belözoğlu Fenerbahçe için imzayı attı: "Hedefimiz şampiyonluk ve kupalar"
news.summaryTr: Fenerbahçe'nin yeni teknik direktörü Emre Belözoğlu için Chobani Stadı'nda imza töreni düzenlendi. Sarı-lacivertli takıma yeniden dönen Belözoğlu, şampiyonluk hedefini vurgulayarak “Fenerbahçe için tutku ve kalite net kriterler” dedi.
news.articleText: Emre Belözoğlu Fenerbahçe için imzayı attı: "Hedefimiz şampiyonluk ve kupalar" - Fenerbahçe'nin yeni teknik direktörü Emre Belözoğlu için Chobani Stadı'nda imza töreni düzenlendi. - Sarı-lacivertli takıma yeniden dönen Belözoğlu, şampiyonluk hedefini vurgulayarak "Fenerbahçe için tutku ve kalite net kriterler." dedi. Fenerbahçe Kulübü, teknik direktör Emre Belözoğlu için imza töreni düzenledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Chobani Stadı'nda gerçekleştirilen törende Belözoğlu'nun yanı sıra yöneticiler Önder Fırat ve Cihan Kamer de basın mensuplarının sorularını yanıtladı. Fenerbahçe'ye yeniden dönmenin gururunu yaşadığını belirten Belözoğlu, camianın beklentilerinin farkında olduğunu söyledi. Teknik direktörlük sürecinde kendisini geliştirdiğini ifade eden Belözoğlu, kulübün başarısı için çalışmaya geldiğini vurguladı. "Fenerbahçe için net kriterler tutku ve kalitedir." diyen Belözoğlu, bu anlayışı sahaya yansıtmak istediğini belirterek, oyuncularını en kısa sürede hedefledikleri oyun düzenine adapte edeceklerini kaydetti. "BIST 100 dışında değil, kupaların tamamında hedefimiz var" Belözoğlu, Fenerbahçe'nin mücadele ettiği tüm organizasyonlarda iddialı olması gerektiğini belirtti. Hiçbir maçı veya hedefi ikinci plana atamayacaklarını söyleyen teknik adam, Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde ise gerçekçi bir değerlendirme yapmaları gerektiğini ifade etti. Takımın oyuncu kalitesine güvendiğini dile getiren Belözoğlu, “Fenerbahçe'nin güçlü bir kadrosu var. Oyuncu kalitesine inanıyorum, gelmemin sebeplerinden biri de bu oyuncu grubuna inanmak oldu” diye konuştu. Hedefinin uzun yıllar Fenerbahçe'de görev yapmak olduğunu belirten Belözoğlu, yüzüncü teknik direktörün kulübe üst üste şampiyonluklar ve Avrupa kupaları kazandırmasının ardından görevi devretmesini temenni etti. "Ayrışma olduğunu görüyorum" Fenerbahçe camiasında birlik ve beraberliğin önemine dikkat çeken Belözoğlu, dışarıdan baktığında bir ayrışma gördüğünü söyledi. Bu ayrışmayı ortadan kaldıracak bir oyun anlayışı oluşturmak istediklerini belirten Belözoğlu, "Bunu birleştirecek oyunu oynatmak, şampiyonlukları sonuna kadar kovalamak, her kupaya talip olarak camiaya uygun oyun sergilemek en büyük isteğim." ifadelerini kullandı. Belözoğlu, Fenerbahçe'nin haklarını saha dışında da savunacaklarını belirterek, Merkez Hakem Kurulu ve Türkiye Futbol Federasyonu dahil herkesle kulübün hakları çerçevesinde mücadele edeceklerini söyledi. "Kuyt hocaya saygısızlık yapmak istemem" Liverpool karşısında alınan galibiyete de değinen Belözoğlu, maç öncesinde oyuncularla yalnızca tanıştığını ve kulüple ilgili düşüncelerini paylaştığını anlattı. Takımı karşılaşmaya hazırlayan Dirk Kuyt ve ekibine teşekkür eden Belözoğlu, galibiyette kendisinin payı olduğunu söylemenin doğru olmayacağını belirtti. Kuyt'ın durumuna ilişkin değerlendirme sürecinin sürdüğünü, teknik ekibinin ise 12-13 kişiden oluşacağını açıkladı. Yönetimden Belözoğlu'na şampiyonluk desteği Fenerbahçe yöneticisi Cihan Kamer, İsmail Kartal ile yolların ayrıldığını belirterek Emre Belözoğlu ile şampiyonluk yolunda devam etme kararı aldıklarını söyledi. Önder Fırat da Belözoğlu'nun bilgi, birikim ve tecrübesine güvendiklerini ifade ederek yönetim olarak yeni teknik direktöre destek vereceklerini kaydetti. Emre Belözoğlu'nun kariyeri Futbolculuk kariyerini noktalamasının ardından 15 Ağustos 2020 tarihinde Fenerbahçe'de sportif direktörlük görevine getirilen Emre Belözoğlu, 25 Mart 2021 tarihinde Erol Bulut ile yolların ayrılmasının ardından sarı-lacivertlilerin teknik direktörü olmuştu. Zirvenin uzağında aldığı sarı-lacivertlileri son haftaya kadar şampiyonluk yarışında tutan Belözoğlu, sezonun sona ermesinin ardından görevinden ayrılmıştı. 12 Ekim 2021 tarihinde Başakşehir'le anlaşan genç teknik adam, burada geçirdiği 2 yılda 88 maça çıktı. 2021-22 sezonunda devraldığı takımını ilk 4'e sokan Belözoğlu, 2022-23 sezonunda 5. sırada yer aldı. 2023-24 sezonuna da Başakşehir'de başlayan Emre Belözoğlu, takımının ligde aldığı üst üste 3 yenilgi sonrası görevinden ayrılmıştı. 6 Eylül 2023'te Başakşehir'den ayrılan Belözoğlu, bir süre sonra 5 Ekim 2023 tarihinde Ankaragücü'nün başına geçti. Başkent ekibiyle kümede kalma mücadelesi veren Emre Belözoğlu, takımının bir alt lige düşmesine engel olamadı ve sezonun bitimiyle görevindena yrıldı. 17 Ocak 2025'te yeniden sahalara dönen Belözoğlu, Antalyaspor'un başına getirildi. Akdeniz ekibiyle 28 maça çıkan ve takımını ligde tutan Emre Belözoğlu, 8 Ekim 2025'te veda etti. Şu anda Kasımpaşa'yı çalıştıran Belözoğlu, buradaki görevine 5 Aralık 2025'te başladı. Belözoğlu, 3 Kasım'da Fenerbahçe ile anlaşmaya vardı.

Başkent ekibiyle kümede kalma mücadelesi veren Emre Belözoğlu, takımının bir alt lige düşmesine engel olamadı ve sezonun bitimiyle görevindena yrıldı. 17 Ocak 2025'te yeniden sahalara dönen Belözoğlu, Antalyaspor'un başına getirildi. Akdeniz ekibiyle 28 maça çıkan ve takımını ligde tutan Emre Belözoğlu, 8 Ekim 2025'te veda etti. Şu anda Kasımpaşa'yı çalıştıran Belözoğlu, buradaki görevine 5 Aralık 2025'te başladı. Belözoğlu, 3 Kasım'da Fenerbahçe ile anlaşmaya vardı.

news.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
news.summary: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.

news.titleTr: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
news.summaryTr: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.
news.articleText: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values - Published Shares in artificial intelligence and technology firms have started to climb following an enormous sell-off on Thursday that wiped trillions of dollars off stock values. The tech-heavy Nasdaq stock index opened higher following a market rout that began in the US on Thursday before spilling over to Asian and European markets into Friday. Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat victory in the midterm elections would mean slower artificial intelligence development. However the latest US employment figures added to a mixed picture for American markets on Friday morning, with an unexpectedly strong 165,000 jobs added to the economy in September. The Nasdaq Composite opened up 1.23% and continued to gain in early trading, reversing some of its 5.5% fall from Thursday. The S&P 500 - home of the largest publicly-traded US companies that are not in the technology sector - also opened up slightly, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average opened a little down. Firms that experienced heavy losses on Thursday also began to bounce back in early trading. Nvida, which shed hundreds of billions in market value on Thursday after shares slid more than 9%, began Friday trading up more than 6%. SpaceX and Tesla shares, which were also hammered on Thursday, saw more mixed gains, up more than 7% and nearly 3% respectively. The market fluctuations come after the sweeping Democrat victory in the midterm elections. A number of Democrats campaigned for new rules and regulations for artificial intelligence (AI) and data centres, and the party has since won control of both houses of congress as well as key contests in states that have been part of the AI data centre race. US President Donald Trump on Friday reiterated his supported for what he calls "super intelligence", saying only "foolish leadership" would "say no to the riches they bring". However, there have also been concerns over whether the enormous amounts of money being spent on AI will pay off. - Could the US midterms put a pin in the AI bubble? - Published10 minutes ago As well as the fallout of the midterms and the plunge in artificial intelligence stocks, US traders will also be digesting the latest jobs figures. And those numbers were better than expected: US employers added 165,000 new jobs in October, well above the average monthly increase and more than double what analysts had expected. Overall the unemployment rate, which counts the number of people who are out of work but actively looking for a job, eased slightly to 4.1% from 4.2% in September. The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) said the unemployment rate has remained in the narrow range of 4.1% to 4.3% since March. The increase in jobs was led by the professional and business services sector, which added 70,000 jobs. The healthcare sector added 42,000 jobs, and jobs were also added in transportation and warehousing as well as manufacturing. Neil Birrell, chief investment officer at investment firm Premier Miton, said while the jobs figures may feel like second billing to the market movements they were still important. "The US economy is running hard which may mean the risks the markets are worrying about at the moment are not such a risk to the real economy as is being feared," he said.
